title: Analista FP&A júnior
description:
A falta de tempo sempre foi considerada inimiga da alimentação saudável. Quem nunca precisou recorrer a “fast-food pesadão” por dispor de apenas alguns minutos para almoçar?


Para nós 10 minutos é tempo de sobra para você preparar ou receber refeições deliciosas e saudáveis!

Após duas décadas no ramo de alimentação, hoje atuamos com a Cumbuca Boa e a Piadina Romagnola.


A Cumbuca Boa é um e-commerce que oferece comida ultracongelada, saudável e deliciosa. Que nasceu para democratizar o acesso a uma alimentação de qualidade e quebrar de vez o tabu da comida congelada, acredite se quiser… Ou melhor, experimente e dê sua opinião!

A empresa tem como propósito revitalizar a imagem da comida instantânea, proporcionando refeições ultra-rápidas e com a qualidade de comida feita em casa. Nosso crescimento e os constantes elogios comprovam que nossos clientes estão de acordo.


A Piadina Romagnola é o resultado de um sonho antigo de construir uma empresa no ramo da alimentação. Nela oferecemos um sanduíche delicioso e tradicional, a Piadina, muito mais saudável e equilibrado que as opções mais comuns. Fundada em 2012 com a primeira unidade no Morumbi Shopping, atua hoje em 15 unidades localizadas em alguns do melhores pontos da cidade de São Paulo, atendendo cerca de 80.000 clientes/mês.

Tanto na Cumbuca quanto na Piadina nossa missão é uma só: encantar nossos clientes todos os dias através de uma alimentação deliciosa, saudável e prática.

Nossos principais ingredientes são amor e carinho.


Gostamos de proporcionar o bem aos outros, seja através da nossa comida, seja através da nossa forma de trabalhar.


Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe qualidade

Procuramos fazer as coisas bem feitas

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe proatividade

Gostamos de gente que faz

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe criatividade

Novas idéias são sempre bem-vindas.

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe cooperação

Cultivamos um ambiente onde todos constroem juntos.

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe ambição

Não temos limite pra crescer

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabem todos os sonhos do mundo

Se você sonha com um mundo mais saudável, vem sonhar com a gente!


Descrição da Vaga


Encontrar uma empresa jovem, com um ambiente aberto, dinâmico e sempre orientado à satisfação de nossos clientes. Estamos em uma fase de crescimento acelerado nas duas empresas, o que prova que estamos no caminho certo! Fazer parte dessa fase significa vivenciar algo único: uma empresa que hoje é pequena, mas que amanhã pode ter o tamanho dos sonhos das pessoas que dela fazem parte.


Para sonhar com o nosso apetite de crescimento, precisamos de uma pessoa que tenha experiência ou deseje aprender sobre área de Operações. Alguém que tenha conhecimento, pró atividade e discernimento para, com o passar do tempo, prever e antecipar demandas e próximos passos.


Objetivo


Atuar no planejamento e análise financeira da companhia, fornecendo informações confiáveis, análises críticas e indicadores que suportem a tomada de decisão da diretoria. O Analista de FP&A será responsável por acompanhar o desempenho financeiro e operacional do negócio, identificar desvios, propor melhorias e contribuir para o aumento da rentabilidade, eficiência e previsibilidade dos resultados.


Nessa posição


Buscamos um(a) Analista de FP&A para atuar diretamente no planejamento financeiro, análise de resultados e suporte à tomada de decisão da companhia. Procuramos alguém com forte capacidade analítica, perfil proativo e que goste de estruturar processos e transformar dados em informações úteis para o negócio.


  • Elaborar e acompanhar Orçamento, Comitê Financeiro, Relatório trimestral.
  • Desenvolver e atualizar modelos financeiros.
  • Analisar DRE, balanço patrimonial e fluxo de caixa.
  • Elaborar apresentações executivas para diretoria e sócios.
  • Construir e acompanhar indicadores financeiros e operacionais (KPIs).
  • Realizar análises de rentabilidade por produto, canal, loja e unidade de negócio.
  • Apoiar projetos de redução de custos e aumento de eficiência.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Contabilidade, Compras, Operações para garantir a qualidade das informações financeiras.
  • Participar da melhoria contínua dos processos financeiros e da implantação de sistemas PROTHEUS.


Requisitos Técnicos:


  • Formação em Administração de Empresas, Contabilidade, Economia ou Engenharia.
  • Experiência em FP&A, Controladoria, Consultoria ou áreas financeiras.
  • Bons conhecimentos de Excel e Power Point
  • Capacidade analítica e raciocínio lógico;
  • Habilidade para aprender, pensar e trabalhar rápido
  • Boa comunicação
  • Atenção a detalhes e organização ímpar


Como se trata de uma empresa jovem, pensamos numa posição majoritariamente presencial. Estamos localizados no Bairro Vila Cordeiro, São Paulo, 10 minutos da estação de metro Brooklin.

title: National Sales Director (Brazil)
description:
Job Title: National Sales Director - Brazil

Reports To: Head of Overseas Business Unit

Location: Brazil (Remote, frequent travel required)


Position Overview

To support the company's strategic development, we are investing significantly in the Brazilian market to accelerate brand growth, product localization, and sales network expansion. We are seeking a National Sales Director for Brazil who will be responsible for the overall market strategy, sales planning, channel development, and team leadership. The goal is to rapidly achieve broad product coverage across Brazil and develop tailored product and sales strategies for the local market.

The ideal candidate will have established nationwide distributor and customer relationships, enabling them to contribute immediately. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience at leading baking ingredient manufacturers in a similar role.


Key Responsibilities

A. Market Strategy & Planning

  1. Develop and execute the overall sales strategy, channel plan, and annual business objectives for Brazil.
  2. Lead product localization initiatives to meet Brazilian market needs and drive product adaptation.
  3. Rapidly expand the national sales network to ensure broad market coverage.

B. Channel Development & Management

  1. Identify, negotiate with, and onboard national distributors and key strategic partners.
  2. Manage relationships with distributors and major customers, optimizing processes and service delivery.
  3. Maintain distributor and customer profiles, conduct regular performance reviews, and implement improvement plans.

C. Brand & Marketing Promotion

  1. Develop and implement brand-building activities, including marketing campaigns, PR events, and digital outreach.
  2. Organize product demonstrations, technical trainings, and industry exhibitions to increase brand visibility.

D. Cross-functional Collaboration

  1. Work closely with product, R&D, and marketing teams to share market insights and support product development.
  2. Provide training and support to distributors and customers on products, applications, and sales techniques.

E. Market & Competitive Intelligence

  1. Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and regulatory changes to adjust strategies proactively.
  2. Prepare regular market reports and business forecasts for headquarters.


Qualifications

A. Experience

  1. Minimum 15 years of sales management experience in the baking ingredients industry, with a focus on non-dairy whipping toppings or related products, specifically in the Brazilian market.
  2. Previous experience in a similar role at companies is highly preferred.
  3. Established network of national distributors and key clients, with the ability to execute quickly.

B. Knowledge

  1. Full understanding of bakery products and familiarity with bakery operations or production processes.
  2. Proficient in Microsoft Office for data analysis, reporting, and presentation.

C. Competency

  1. Strong strategic thinking, negotiation skills, and business acumen.
  2. Resilient under pressure and willing to travel frequently.
  3. Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.


We Offer

  1. Competitive compensation package.
  2. Opportunity to lead in a high-priority strategic market with significant growth potential.
  3. Full support from global headquarters in product, marketing, and technical resources.



About Hi-Road Food Technology

Shanghai Hi-road Food Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading integrated enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of premium bakery and catering ingredients. Committed to becoming the preferred partner in the global baking industry, we dedicate ourselves to providing customers with innovative, safe, and delicious food solutions.

With our strong independent R&D capabilities, Hi-Road meticulously sources world-class raw materials and employs advanced production technologies. Our comprehensive quality control system ensures the consistent excellence of our diverse product portfolio, which includes:

•Dairy and non-dairy toppings

•Premium fruit preparations

•Chocolate products

•Bakery creams and margarine compounds

•Flavor sauces

•Food flavors and additives

Through continuous innovation and stringent quality standards, we strive to deliver exceptional value and culinary inspiration to our partners worldwide
company: 上海海融食品科技股份有限公司 Hi-Road Food Technology

title: Collections Operations Lead – Brazil (LATAM Expansion)
description:
Ant International is a global leader in digital payments and financial technology, dedicated to connecting the world through inclusive and innovative solutions. As we expand our Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) footprint in Brazil, we are looking for an entrepreneurial Collections Operations Lead to build, scale, and optimize our local operations—with a roadmap to extend coverage across Latin America (including Mexico).


The Role

This is a high-impact, founding role within our Brazil collections team. You won't just manage existing processes—you will build them from the ground up. You will drive end-to-end execution across strategy deployment, BPO management, regulatory compliance, and cutting-edge AI tool integration.


Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Operations: Design and execute the full-cycle collections strategy for BNPL in Brazil, from early-stage reminders to late-stage recovery.
  • AI & Tech Innovation: Lead the evaluation, testing, and deployment of AI-driven collection solutions (conversational AI, smart dialers) and multi-channel communications (WhatsApp, Voice, SMS, RCS).
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all operations strictly align with local laws and regulations (LGPD, BACEN, Consumer Protection Code).
  • Data Analytics & Performance: Track core KPIs (Contact, PTP, Cure, Roll, and Recovery rates), build customer segmentation models, and continuously optimize treatment strategies.
  • BPO & Partner Management: Select, onboard, and manage local BPO vendors, ensuring high performance standards and operational alignment.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Credit Risk to feed post-loan insights back into underwriting models.
  • Regional Expansion: Scale operational frameworks to support future collections setup in Mexico and other LATAM markets.


What We Are Looking For


Must-Have:

  • Fintech/Scale-up Experience: Proven track record in collections operations within leading Fintechs or high-growth consumer credit platforms in LATAM (e.g., 99, Shopee, Nubank, Mercado Pago).
  • Deep Local Market Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of Brazil’s collections landscape, BPO ecosystem, consumer behavior, and financial regulations (LGPD, BACEN).
  • End-to-End Ownership: Hands-on experience spanning strategy design, tool implementation, analytics, and vendor management.
  • Fluent English: Strong written and verbal communication skills to collaborate effectively with global teams.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, or related fields.


Nice-to-Have:

  • Spanish proficiency to support expansion into Spanish-speaking LATAM markets.
  • Direct experience implementing AI voice/chatbots or intelligent dialers.
  • Experience working in multinational or cross-border Fintech environments.
  • Practical SQL or data analysis skills.


Ready to build the future of digital payments in LATAM? Apply now or reach out directly!

title: Accounting Lead
description:

title: Director of Procurement
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).


Key Responsibilities

1. Fully responsible for the company's procurement in the Latin American region, and for developing and optimizing regional procurement strategies.

2. Lead market research in Latin America, analyze regional industry trends, supplier capabilities, and market risks to support the company's procurement strategy and project decision-making.

3. Manage and deeply maintain the regional supplier ecosystem, regularly evaluate the quality of suppliers' products and services, and drive improvements in key supply chain systems.

4. Guide and participate in the negotiation, review, and management of procurement contracts to ensure they are legal and compliant, protecting the company's interests.

5. Develop and implement procurement cost control plans, continuously drive improvements in procurement processes, efficiency, and cost optimization to enhance project profitability.

6. Build and improve regional procurement processes, policies, and systems, promoting standardized procurement and digital advancement to achieve compliant and transparent processes.

7. Collaborate with delivery, operations, and other relevant departments, as well as headquarters resources, to effectively support the smooth execution of regional projects.


Job Requirements

  • 1. Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in a science or engineering major.
  • 2. Over 10 years of experience in procurement or supply chain management, with required experience in procurement in Latin America.
  • 3. Thorough understanding of procurement processes and cross-cultural supplier management, capable of independently leading procurement negotiations and maintaining supplier relationships.
  • 4. Strong cost awareness and data analysis abilities, with proven success in procurement cost control.
  • 5. Strong communication, collaboration, and conflict resolution skills, able to efficiently handle regional procurement emergencies.
  • 6. Highly responsible, self-motivated, big-picture thinker, able to handle pressure at key delivery milestones.
  • 7. Proficient in English, able to frequently travel across Latin American countries.
  • 8. Experience in building and managing procurement systems in the Latin American region for Fortune 500, international energy, or engineering companies is preferred.

title: Internal Auditor
description:
About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.

Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.

Position Overview

VelaFi Brazil is seeking an independent Internal Auditor to establish and execute our internal audit framework required for Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) VASP/PSAV authorization under Resolution BCB No. 552/2025.

In this role, you will objectively evaluate the effectiveness of our governance, risk management processes, AML/CFT controls (Circular BCB No. 3,978/2020), cybersecurity measures, and cross-border payment operations.

Location

Hybrid: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Audit Plan & Execution: Design and execute an annual risk-based internal audit plan approved by the Board of Directors.
  • AML/CFT & Regulatory Testing: Conduct independent testing of AML/CFT controls (KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, sanctions/PEP screening, SAR/ROS procedures).
  • Custody & Segregation Review: Evaluate asset segregation and digital asset custody controls in compliance with BCB regulations (e.g., Res. BCB 520).
  • Cybersecurity & Tech Audits: Assess IT controls, key management, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Business Continuity (BCP), and Disaster Recovery (DRP) frameworks (Res. BCB 552 / Res. BCB 85).
  • Reporting & Escalation: Report findings, control deficiencies, and remediation status directly to the Board. Support mock regulatory audits and pre-filing BCB readiness reviews.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Proven experience in internal/external audit or risk assurance within financial institutions, payment institutions (IP), or licensed VASPs/crypto entities in Brazil.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of the BCB regulatory framework (Res. BCB 552, Circ. 3,978/2020).
  • Certifications: CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CISA, CPA, or equivalent credentials preferred.
  • Languages: Professional fluency in English and Portuguese.

Desired Competencies

  • Financial Controls & Governance: Strong expertise in evaluating internal control frameworks, corporate governance, operational workflows, and segregation of customer assets.
  • Regulatory Reporting & Audit Expertise: Familiarity with BCB audit requirements and regulatory systems, including Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), COSIF accounting frameworks, and AML/CFT compliance.
  • Executive Presence & Independence: Ability to report directly and present objective findings to the Board of Directors and external regulators without operational bias.
  • Strong Analytical & Decision-Making Skills: Demonstrated skill in conducting root-cause analyses, dissecting complex transaction logs, and identifying systemic control gaps.
  • High Accountability & Ownership: Results-driven approach to tracking audit remediation plans and ensuring timely resolution of audit findings.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to collaborate constructively with Compliance, Risk, Engineering, and Finance teams while maintaining strict audit independence.
  • Ability to build scalable audit infrastructure: Experience establishing risk-based internal audit methodologies, automated sampling procedures, and testing frameworks that scale from early-stage authorization to high-volume cross-border operations.

Nice to Have

  • Cross-Border & FX Audit Experience: Background auditing foreign exchange (Câmbio/eFX), international remittance rails, and multi-currency liquidity settlement.
  • Digital Assets & Crypto Auditing: Practical knowledge auditing blockchain transactions, digital asset custody (Res. BCB 520), and stablecoin flows (USDT/USDC).
  • Professional Certifications: Active CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), CFA, or active CRC (Conselho Regional de Contabilidade).
  • RegTech & Automation Tools: Experience testing or auditing automated transaction monitoring, automated BACEN reporting software, and reconciliation engines.

Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.

Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing
description:
The Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing is responsible for leading both the pricing strategy and the tender management lifecycle across a defined geographic region. They oversee all aspects of pricing and bid management to drive competitive, margin‑conscious decisions across multimodal product lines. They partner closely with Sales, Operations, Procurement, and Carrier Management to develop aligned bid strategies and deliver winning tender responses. They build strong relationships with carriers, evaluate market conditions, and lead cross‑functional teams through complex RFQs, RFPs, and tender cycles. They develop regional pricing frameworks, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement in pricing accuracy, tender quality, and commercial outcomes. They also provide strategic insights based on post‑tender evaluations, helping refine future pursuits and improve long‑term profitability.


Responsibilities

  • Oversee and manage the complete pricing and tender lifecycle, including analysis of wins/losses, pipeline performance, and regional pricing positions.
  • Develop and execute clear bid strategies in collaboration with sales, technical teams, and cross‑functional stakeholders, defining win themes, timelines, and resource needs.
  • Lead and motivate cross‑functional bid teams, assigning responsibilities, tracking deliverables, and ensuring timely, high‑quality tender submissions.
  • Conduct comprehensive reviews of RFPs, RFQs, and customer requirements to identify risks, operational considerations, and solution opportunities.
  • Manage regional relationships with air, ocean, and ground carriers, securing competitive rates and optimizing procurement strategies.
  • Develop regional pricing frameworks across multimodal services (ground, intermodal, air, ocean, contract logistics, etc.).
  • Ensure pricing outputs support profitable growth, align with target margins, and reinforce customer value propositions.
  • Partner with Operations to understand cost drivers, service capabilities, network constraints, and profitability levers.
  • Drive pricing strategy in alignment with Regional Sales leadership, ensuring consistency and commercial competitiveness.
  • Maintain visibility of regional pricing and tender pipeline performance, including turnaround time, quality metrics, and commercial outcomes.
  • Conduct post‑tender and post‑award reviews to identify lessons learned and implement continuous improvement best practices.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, market shifts, and procurement practices to guide strategic pricing decisions.
  • Provide training, coaching, and best‑practice guidance to regional sales and support teams on pricing tools and tender processes.
  • Support digital pricing initiatives, workflow standardization, and process optimization across regional teams.
  • All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.


Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Supply Chain, Administration, Foreign Trade, Project Management) from an accredited college or university required.
  • Certification/Licensure: Industry certifications such as CILT, CSCMP, APICS, FIATA, etc. preferred but not required.
  • Languages: English (Advanced) and Native Spanish (Advanced).
  • 3+ years of experience in pricing, tender management, and/or air/ocean freight forwarding.
  • Strong understanding of procurement processes, tender documentation, bid structures, and commercial/legal frameworks.
  • Excellent organizational, planning, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities.
  • Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.
  • Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.).
  • Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in a 100% on‑site setting (listed in this posting), with travel for related meetings/events.

title: Key Account Sales Director
description:
JD Industrials | Director of Key Account Sales, Brazil

Work Location : Brazil (based in São Paulo, regular nationwide business travel)


Reporting to : Latin America Regional Lead


1. Business Overview

  • JD Industrials is the B2B industrial supply chain division of JD Group. We deliver one-stop digital procurement solutions covering MRO spare parts, industrial consumables, electrical automation, tools & security equipment, production materials and other industrial goods, and implement an accompanying global expansion strategy.


  • As Latin America’s largest industrial market, Brazil hosts numerous Chinese enterprises expanding overseas in new energy vehicles, construction machinery, infrastructure engineering, mining and manufacturing, alongside major local industrial conglomerates. JD Industrials has established a local legal entity in Brazil. Leveraging cross-border supply chains, local warehousing & distribution, customs clearance fulfillment and digital procurement platform capabilities, we serve Chinese-owned factories operating in Brazil and leading local industrial clients.


  • As the lead for key account sales in Brazil, this role takes charge of local KA client acquisition, commercial negotiations and long-term account management, builds the key account sales system, and drives sustained revenue growth of industrial goods business in Brazil.


2. Job Responsibilities

  • Key Account Development & Target Delivery

Take overall ownership of acquiring Chinese overseas enterprises and large local KA clients across manufacturing, infrastructure, energy and mining sectors in Brazil. Formulate key account sales strategies and annual business plans, deliver revenue, gross profit and collection targets assigned by headquarters, and secure long-term framework bulk procurement agreements. Independently engage client procurement directors, supply chain leaders and factory management teams; oversee the full lifecycle of business opportunities, tendering, commercial negotiations and contract signing.

  • In-depth Account Management & Demand Mining

Identify procurement pain points at client factories. Combine JD Industrials’ supply chain strengths to deliver customized solutions including MRO consolidated procurement, hybrid cross-border & local fulfillment, and digital procurement services. Continuously increase wallet share among existing clients, tap incremental opportunities across multiple production sites and subsidiaries, and foster long-term strategic partnerships.

  • Local Market & Competition Analysis

Continuously research Brazil’s industrial goods market regulations, major competitors, pricing frameworks of local suppliers, industry policies and import customs requirements. Produce periodic market analysis reports, feed client demands and category opportunities back to the regional headquarters, and support optimization of localized product assortments and fulfillment solutions for Brazil.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration & Project Execution

Coordinate with local Brazil teams covering operations, supply chain, customs and finance, as well as procurement & sales teams at China headquarters. Manage end-to-end order fulfillment, delivery tracking, invoicing & payment collection, and after-sales issue resolution. Control client receivables risks to maintain healthy cash flow.

Sales Team Building & Management (0-to-1 Local Team Establishment)

Build a local Brazilian key account sales talent pipeline aligned with business progress. Set individual KPIs and performance appraisal mechanisms. Equip the team with capabilities for business development and solution-based industrial sales, and coordinate joint efforts to deliver priority projects.

  • Ecosystem Partner Development

Engage local industry associations, channel partners and logistics service providers appropriately to expand lead sources and cultivate a sound local business ecosystem.


3. Job Requirements

  • Education & Language

Bachelor’s degree or above; fluent Portuguese (mandatory for commercial negotiations); English as working auxiliary language. Proficiency in Chinese is preferred (significant advantage for engaging Chinese enterprises).

Industry Experience (Mandatory)

Minimum 8 years of B2B industrial goods key account sales or sales management experience, with deep expertise in MRO, industrial spare parts, electrical equipment, tools, security products, automation and engineering materials. Familiar with industrial bulk procurement models and factory procurement decision-making chains.

Hands-on experience operating in the Brazilian market and existing client resources in manufacturing, new energy, infrastructure and mining sectors are preferred. Prior experience serving Chinese enterprises expanding overseas is a plus.

  • Core Competencies

Proven track record of 0-to-1 overseas market development. Expertise in annual bulk procurement negotiations and framework agreement management for large conglomerates. Basic understanding of cross-border industrial trade, import customs clearance and localized fulfillment. Result-oriented mindset with strong awareness of receivables risk control.

Capable of independently managing client projects with annual transaction volumes ranging from millions to tens of millions. Adept at solution-based sales instead of pure product trading.

  • Work Location Adaptability

Long-term assignment in Brazil; able to undertake frequent inter-city business travel within Brazil. Familiar with Brazilian business culture, labor laws and trade regulations. Comfortable with cross-time-zone collaboration with China headquarters.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Working experience with Schneider Electric, 3M, Grainger, RS Components, MISUMI, major local industrial distributors or cross-border industrial supply chain companies;


  • Understanding of industrial e-commerce and digital procurement platform business models;


  • Established senior-level connections with Chinese-owned factories or local industrial conglomerates in Brazil.

title: Keeta-业务目标分析管理专家（base 巴西）
description:
1. 业务目标/绩效体系搭建 承接组织目标和业务节奏，负责业务团队目标体系的系统性设计与拆解，涵盖中长期业务规划、季度/月度目标设定、业务达成路径拆解及资源匹配；确保组织目标的一致性与可承接性，同时主导绩效体系的设计和运营，确保业务团队绩效方案的及时和准确性，支持业务团队拿到结果。 2. 市场与业务动态跟踪分析 系统跟踪市场动态、竞争格局与业务节奏，持续评估目标合理性，及时主动调整目标以匹配业务阶段与策略变化；建立健全、整合的目标追踪机制，输出有数据支撑的经营分析报告（MBR/WBR/DBR），支持管理层决策。探索将AI/机器学习工具应用于业务异动预警与趋势预测，提升分析的前瞻性与时效性。 3. 专项经营分析与决策支持 针对重点业务问题开展深度专项研究，综合运用数据分析、用户洞察、市场研究等手段，输出有落地价值的策略建议；能够独立承接从问题定义、框架设计到结论呈现的全链路分析工作，为管理层提供高质量的经营洞察。

岗位要求:

1.本科及以上学历，数学、统计学、商业分析或商科相关专业； 2.5年及以上商业分析/目标管理/经营分析相关经验；有头部互联网或咨询公司背景者优先；有外卖/本地生活/电商平台经历者优先； 3.具备优秀的结构化思维能力，能够对复杂业务问题进行独立拆解与量化建模； 4.熟练使用SQL进行数据提取与分析，掌握至少一种数据可视化/分析工具；具备扎实的数理统计基本功； 5.对AI工具在商业分析/目标管理场景的应用有实战经验或浓厚兴趣，了解LLM辅助分析、AI预测模型等在经营管理中的落地逻辑；在使用AI工具过程中，严格遵守公司及所在国家/地区的数据安全与合规要求，确保业务数据、用户数据不被违规输入外部AI系统，具备数据安全意识与合规操作习惯； 6.具备优秀的跨部门沟通与协作能力，能够高效推动多方资源对齐，将分析结论转化为可执行的业务动作。

岗位亮点:

title: Business Analyst
description:

The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that business needs are accurately captured, documented, and translated into functional requirements that support successful project delivery.

  • Understand, analyze, and document functional and non-functional requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Advanced English (written and verbal).
  • Previous experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst .
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience with Azure DevOps .
  • Experience working on software development projects.

  • Experience working with server-based applications and understanding non-functional requirements.
  • Strong skills in business process analysis and documentation.
  • Experience creating and maintaining technical and functional documentation.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project coordination skills.
  • Solid mathematical and logical reasoning capabilities.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with global and cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in Agile environments.

title: Survey & Insights Analyst
description:
Your Responsibilities:

The Survey & Insights Analyst supports Lockton's enterprise survey consultancy function, partnering with business units and geographies worldwide to design, deploy, and analyze surveys that create actionable insights. This role serves as a hands-on Qualtrics practitioner and analytical partner, helping internal teams translate research questions into survey programs and actionable findings while upholding data governance and privacy standards across regions.


Essential Duties:

  • Design, build, and program surveys in Qualtrics, including logic/branching, bilingual and multi-language routing, embedded data, and distribution workflows.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for survey methodology, question design, and data quality across a portfolio of internal and client-facing survey programs.
  • Partner with stakeholders across regions and business units to scope survey requests, define objectives, and translate business questions into effective instrument design.
  • Clean, analyze, and synthesize survey data into reports, dashboards, and presentations for management and Associates.
  • Support data governance efforts, including PII/PHI risk review, survey inventory management, and adherence to global privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
  • Provide consulting, training, and technical support to survey requestors throughout the survey lifecycle, from intake through post-deployment analysis.
  • Monitor project timelines and maintain responsibility for delivering accurate, on-time deliverables.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical, audiences.


Other Responsibilities:

  • Provides exceptional customer service and adheres to the Lockton philosophies
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with IT PMO, Digital Office, and People Solutions teams as needed


Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree required
  • 1+ years of experience in survey research, data analysis, market research, or a related analytical field
  • Demonstrated experience building and administering surveys in Qualtrics (or a comparable enterprise survey platform) required
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel required; experience with Power BI strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of Python and SQL for data manipulation or automation preferred, but not required
  • Excellent written and spoken English proficiency required, given regular collaboration with international, multi-lingual stakeholders
  • Familiarity with survey methodology best practices, including question design and sampling.
  • Awareness of data privacy principles and regulations relevant to survey data (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) a plus
  • Ability to express complex technical concepts effectively, both verbally and in writing, to non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze data from multiple sources and provide clear, actionable recommendations
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple concurrent projects without sacrificing quality or accuracy
  • Comfortable working across time zones with globally distributed teams; some flexibility in working hours may be required

O profissional será responsável por analisar dados e relatórios disponibilizados em ambiente GCP, desenvolver processos de conciliação contábil, validar a integridade das informações e identificar fragilidades nos controles e nas bases de dados.

A posição demanda elevada capacidade analítica, conhecimento contábil e experiência na construção de reconciliações que assegurem a rastreabilidade completa entre eventos operacionais, financeiros e contábeis.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Construir e executar conciliações analíticas contábeis das operações de Cartão de Crédito.

Experiência

  • Conhecimento das operações de Cartão de Crédito, produtos de crédito, financiamento e seguros.
  • Vivência em Instituições Financeiras, Bancos, Fintechs ou Processadoras.
  • Experiência na análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Atuação em projetos de implantação, migração ou transformação de processos financeiros.


Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Conciliação Contábil e Reconciliação Analítica.
  • Fechamento Contábil.
  • Excel Avançado.
  • SQL Avançado.
  • GCP / BigQuery.
  • Power BI, Looker ou ferramentas de visualização.
  • Governança e Qualidade de Dados.
  • Controles Internos e Gestão de Riscos.


Competências

  • Visão crítica para identificação de gaps e riscos.
  • Senso de prioridade e organização.

description:
RESUMO DO CARGO


Gerenciar os processos de planejamento de produção de latas e tampas da AMP Brasil do curto prazo, garantindo a otimização de nossos recursos e o capital empregado em nossos estoques, de acordo com os planos aprovados pela Diretoria.

  1. Atualizar os principais indicadores e relatórios da área, tais como: Ocupação de Estoque, Slow Moving , Aderência à Política de Estoque etc.;
  2. Realizar o sequenciamento (scheduling) das linhas de produção de latas e tampas à nível SKU, de acordo com pedidos, política de estoque e/ou acordos comerciais, garantindo que as premissas e restrições operacionais estão sendo seguidas;

Conduzir o ciclo de planejamento de curto prazo (ITP) para latas e tampas à nível produto, com frequência semanal, analisando o cenário de atendimento da demanda, ocupação de estoque, aderência à política de estoque, alocação de estoque, deslocamentos de vendas e otimização de recursos, garantindo a eficiência do processo, bem como preparar o material e conduzir a reunião;

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.


Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)


Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

title: Human Resources Manager(Mandarin preferred)
description:
The ideal candidate will support the full scope of Human Resources responsibilities and partner with the organization on strategic initiatives. They will maintain and enhance the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating human resources policies, programs, and practices.


Responsibilities

  1. Develop and implement the HR strategic plan for the Latin America region, and regularly prepare HR status analysis reports.
  2. Oversee recruitment for job vacancies in the Latin America region, and participate in the annual and periodic centralized recruitment organized by headquarters.
  3. Optimize the employee performance indicator system in the Latin America region, and organize and implement performance appraisals and incentive programs.
  4. Establish a local compensation system for the Latin America region, communicate and enforce compensation policies, review employee payroll, and conduct monthly headcount and labor cost statistics.
  5. In accordance with headquarters' HR management policies, build a promotion and dismissal mechanism for employees in the Latin America region, handle daily management matters, and report to headquarters for approval.
  6. Develop localized training plans for the Latin America region and organize the implementation of relevant training programs.
  7. Manage the local HR team and provide professional support and guidance for the team's daily work.
  8. Prepare the annual headcount plan, labor cost budget, and fixed asset budget.
  9. Supervise and manage the localized administrative operations in the Latin America region.
  10. Complete other ad-hoc tasks assigned by leadership.


Qualifications

  1. Education: Bachelor's degree or above in HR or related management fields.
  2. Experience: 3+ years of HR management experience in Latin America.
  3. Knowledge: General business management; HR management; Latin American labor market and regulations.
  4. Skills: Proficient in writing, negotiation, and MS Office.
  5. Competencies: Strong planning, organization, coordination, analysis, communication, and interpersonal skills; excellent cross-cultural and team collaboration abilities.
  6. Special Requirements: English as working language; prior HR experience in Latin America.
  7. Preferred: Chinese language skills are a plus.


岗位简介

全面负责人力资源全模块管理工作，作为业务伙伴深度协同各部门，推动战略性人力举措落地。通过规划、执行与优化人力资源政策及项目，持续提升组织效能与人才管理水平

岗位职责

  1. 制定并实施拉美区域人力资源战略规划，定期撰写人力资源状况分析报告。
  2. 负责拉美区域岗位空缺的招聘工作，并参与总部组织的年度及阶段性统一招聘。
  3. 优化拉美区域员工绩效指标体系，组织并实施绩效考核与激励方案。
  4. 制定拉美区域属地薪酬制度，宣贯执行薪酬制度，审核员工工资，月度人员信息及人工成本统计。
  5. 依据总部人力资源管理制度，构建拉美区域员工晋升与淘汰机制，负责日常管理并报总部审批。
  6. 制定拉美区域属地化培训计划，并组织实施相关培训项目。
  7. 管理当地人力资源团队，为团队日常工作提供专业支持与指导。
  8. 负责年度人员编制、人工成本预算及固定资产预算的编制工作。
  9. 监督并管理拉美区域属地化行政工作的开展。
  10. 完成领导临时交办的工作。

任职要求

  • 教育背景 ：本科及以上学历，人力资源或相关管理类专业。
  • 工作经验 ：3年及以上拉美区域人力资源管理工作经验。
  • 知识要求 ：了解基本企业管理知识，熟悉人力资源管理知识，熟悉拉美地区人力资源市场动态及相关劳动政策法规。
  • 基本技能 ：具备一定的写作能力、谈判能力，能够熟练操作计算机办公软件。
  • 核心能力 ：具有较强的计划、组织、协调、分析、沟通、人际交往、语言和文字表达能力。具备出色的跨文化沟通能力及团队协作精神。
  • 特殊要求 ：英语可作为工作语言，有拉美地区人力资源从业经验。
  • 优先条件 ：具备中文语言能力者优先考虑。

title: Analista de Planejamento de Compras e Importação
description:
Analista de Planejamento de Compras e Importação


Título da vaga: Analista de Planejamento de Compras e Importação (Pleno/Sênior)


Local: São Paulo – SP (Perdizes) · Presencial · CLT


Sobre a posição

Empresa importadora do segmento de produtos médicos busca Analista de Planejamento de Compras e Importação para estruturar a inteligência de compras e abastecimento. É uma posição nova e estratégica: o foco não é o operacional de despacho, e sim a camada analítica que decide o que comprar, quando, de qual fornecedor e a que custo total.


Responsabilidades

  • Planejar compras e importação com base em demanda, giro de estoque e custo (timing, volume e escolha de fornecedor).
  • Calcular e analisar o custo total de importação (landed cost) por produto, acompanhando margem.
  • Gerir o estoque de forma analítica: cobertura, giro, ruptura e ponto de recompra.
  • Apoiar a negociação com fornecedores internacionais com base em dados.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe operacional de importação e a área financeira.

Requisitos

  • 3 a 6 anos de experiência em planejamento de compras, suprimentos, supply/demand planning, S&OP ou importação com viés analítico.
  • Forte capacidade analítica: confortável com dados, planilhas e construção de cenários — não apenas com a execução de processos.
  • Conhecimento de comércio exterior e custo de importação.
  • Excel/planilhas em nível avançado.
  • Visão de negócio: capacidade de transformar números em recomendação de compra.

Diferenciais (direção de crescimento da posição)

  • Vivência em planejamento financeiro / FP&A: projeção de fluxo de caixa, DRE gerencial, modelagem.
  • A posição evolui para integrar planejamento de compras e planejamento financeiro — buscamos quem queira desenvolver essa visão ampla.

Oferecemos

  • Salário CLT de R$ 6.000 a R$ 8.000, conforme experiência.
  • Benefícios: VT, VR/VA, plano de saúde
  • Posição nova, com autonomia para estruturar a área e reporte direto à diretoria.

title: Analista de planejamento financeiro Sênior
description:

Neste papel, você será responsável por:

  • Desenvolver e manter modelos de projeção financeira (curto, médio e longo prazo);
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento anual e realizar o forecast periódico;
  • Criar e aprimorar dashboards e relatórios gerenciais utilizando Excel avançado, Power BI ou ferramentas similares;
  • Realizar análises de variação (real vs. budget/forecast), identificando causas-raiz dos desvios e apresentando insights;
  • Garantir a integridade e consistência dos dados, atuando como um pilar de confiança nas informações gerenciais;
  • Apoiar diretamente a liderança com análises detalhadas e recomendações estratégicas.


O que você precisa para se destacar:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em instituições financeiras, com conhecimento em produtos financeiros de varejo (crédito imobiliário, veículos, entre outros);
  • Domínio em Excel avançado (fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros);
  • Vivência prática em modelagem financeira, projeções e análise de cenários;
  • Experiência com Power BI ou outras ferramentas de visualização de dados;
  • Trajetória sólida em processos de budget, forecast e análise de variação;
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva para traduzir números em insights acionáveis para diferentes áreas.


Perfil comportamental desejado:

  • Analítico e orientado a resultados , com uma mente curiosa para descobrir o “porquê” por trás dos números;
  • Proativo, com iniciativa para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e otimização de processos;
  • Organizado, metódico e com extrema atenção aos detalhes;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com agilidade sob pressão e cumprir prazos desafiadores;
  • Visão estratégica, sempre conectando as análises aos objetivos de negócio.


Esta oportunidade é para você se:

Você é um(a) profissional que vai além do relatório, buscando o impacto real dos números. Se você combina profundidade técnica em finanças e ferramentas de análise com a capacidade de comunicar ideias de forma eficaz e apoiar decisões, queremos conhecê-lo(a)!

title: Garena Internship 2027
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

Are you ready to be a part of the world’s most popular mobile game company? We are looking for driven students to join our Internship Program 2027, where you will have the opportunity to choose your focus track: Operations or Marketing.


You will be an integral part of our core squad, mastering the product from the inside out and taking ownership of the engines that keep the game alive and thriving. This role is designed to fast-track you, tailored to your chosen path:


Operations Track: You will focus on product execution and live systems. Your responsibilities include managing the in-game economy, planning and executing major regional live events, and using data analysis to optimize player retention and ensure seamless daily game operations.


Marketing Track: You will focus on growth, branding, and player acquisition. Your responsibilities include planning and executing high-impact marketing campaigns, analyzing user acquisition (UA) performance data to maximize campaign ROI, and managing local influencer networks and community strategies to expand and engage our player base.


Our ideal candidate would be able to run with us, adapt to our employees' needs, and stay humble throughout. If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we'd love to work with you!


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Exclusivity contract required.


Requirements

  • Education: Pursuing a Bachelor’s degree with an expected graduation date of December 2027 or later.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, with proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking.
  • Passion for games: You must be an active player, have deep knowledge of gaming mechanics, meta-trends, and player psychology.
  • Analytical Excellence: Ability to use data to justify operational decisions and optimize the player experience.
  • Availability: able to work in a hybrid model for 30 hours per week (6h/day) starting January 2027 in São Paulo/SP.


Are you ready to Join the Game? Apply now and show us why you are the perfect fit for Garena.

title: Senior Revenue Accountant – US GAAP & Process Automation
description:
Accounting Data Analyst — Revenue

As one of the top mobility companies in the world, we have been redefining the industry with innovative mobile technologies since 2013, driving us toward becoming a super app. Join us in our mission to combat global injustice.


We are looking for an experienced accounting professional with strong technical and data skills to join our global Accounting team. In this role, you'll prepare journal entries, account reconciliations, and revenue data packages that keep our books accurate, auditable, and US GAAP compliant — while writing the SQL and building the automation that makes those processes scalable as we prepare for public company readiness.

You'll report to a US-based Revenue Accounting leader (Eastern Time) and partner daily with accounting, data, and payment reconciliation colleagues across the globe. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable posting a journal entry in an ERP and querying a data warehouse — and who gets energized by fixing broken processes, not just running them.


What You'll Do

  • Prepare complete, review-ready journal entries across revenue, accounts receivable, payment provider settlements, chargebacks/refunds, taxes, and intercompany — with full supporting detail for ERP posting
  • Prepare account reconciliations, flux analyses, and supporting schedules for monthly, quarterly, and annual close
  • Write and maintain SQL queries against our data warehouse to extract and validate the data behind accruals and ASC 606 revenue recognition
  • Support payment service provider (PSP) reconciliations — validating settlement, refund, chargeback, and fee data across geographies and currencies, and flagging discrepancies
  • Document processes end-to-end and support SOX readiness, responding to internal and external audit requests as the preparer with full traceability from source to output
  • Identify manual, error-prone steps and automate them — including with AI-enabled tooling — partnering with Data Engineering, IT, and FinTech teams


What We're Looking For

  • ~8 years of progressive accounting experience, including hands-on journal entry preparation and month-end close ownership
  • Accounting degree with CRC or equivalent professional qualification (CPA-equivalent)
  • Solid working knowledge of US GAAP; hands-on ASC 606 revenue recognition experience is a major plus
  • Strong SQL skills — able to write and adapt queries against large-scale data warehouses (BigQuery or similar)
  • Proficiency with an ERP system (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle or similar): chart of accounts, journal entry posting, validation, and drill-down analysis
  • Experience supporting internal or external audits; exposure to SOX controls and documentation
  • Fluent English — this role works daily with a US-based team during Eastern Time hours


Nice to Have

  • Big 4 or large multinational (Fortune 500-scale) background; IPO or public company readiness experience
  • Industry experience with complex, high-volume revenue models (tech/marketplace, retail, media, manufacturing)
  • Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) and scripting for automation


Who Thrives Here

Someone gritty and curious who gets into the weeds, asks questions, and comes with proposed solutions. We're moving fast toward a bigger goal: priorities pivot, hours can stretch during peak periods, and feedback is direct. If you like ambiguity, ownership, and building processes that didn't exist yesterday, you'll fit right in!


What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Comprehensive medical insurance coverage.
  • Meal allowance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Hybrid setting
  • Opportunity for advancement and upward mobility within the organization, allowing for increased levels of responsibility and growth within the company

title: Analista de Ponto Eletrônico Sênior | Administração de Pessoal
description:
Sobre a AutoZone

A AutoZone é uma empresa americana e multinacional, listada na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York, reconhecida como a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo. Atualmente, possui mais de 7.000 lojas distribuídas pelos Estados Unidos, Porto Rico, México e Brasil, com o apoio de mais de 100.000 AutoZoners em quatro continentes.


No Brasil, a companhia mantém um ritmo acelerado de crescimento, com mais de 162 lojas em sete estados — São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás — além de um escritório corporativo em São Paulo, localizado na Vila Leopoldina. Em 2025, foi inaugurado o Centro de Distribuição próprio em Paulínia/SP, fortalecendo a estrutura logística e sustentando a estratégia de expansão no país.


A AutoZone tem como princípios a mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e o compromisso de ir além. Fazer parte da empresa significa integrar uma equipe que valoriza dedicação, trabalho em equipe e desenvolvimento profissional, oferecendo suporte e ferramentas para o crescimento e construção de carreira dos AutoZoners.


Descrição do Cargo

Responsável pela gestão dos processos de controle de jornada (Ponto eletrônico), garantindo conformidade legal, precisão dos registros e integração com a folha de pagamento. Atua como especialista do sistema WebCenter , suportando a gestão de escalas, monitoramento de indicadores e desenvolvimento de soluções para otimização operacional. Presta consultoria aos gestores em temas relacionados à legislação trabalhista e gestão da força de trabalho, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos e o fortalecimento do compliance. Também lidera iniciativas de melhoria contínua, automação de processos e implantação de sistemas na área de Administração de Pessoal.


Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de ponta a ponta os processos de controle de jornada e frequência, assegurando o correto registro das horas trabalhadas, o fechamento mensal do ponto e a integração com a folha de pagamento.
  • Administrar o sistema WebCenter (próprio da AutoZone), atuando na implementação, configuração, manutenção, gestão de escalas e monitoramento de desvios de jornada, garantindo aderência às necessidades operacionais e de negócio.
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato para gestores em temas relacionados à jornada de trabalho, escalas de turnos, banco de horas e legislação trabalhista, fornecendo orientação, treinamento e suporte técnico.
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados à efetividade operacional, absenteísmo, horas extras, aderência às escalas e produtividade da força de trabalho.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, automação de processos e otimização operacional, propondo soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para a área de Administração de Pessoal.
  • Realizar análises de riscos trabalhistas relacionados à jornada de trabalho, apoiando ações preventivas e corretivas para garantir conformidade legal e reduzir passivos.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, assegurando a conformidade com a legislação trabalhista, normas corporativas e requisitos regulatórios aplicáveis.
  • Participar e liderar iniciativas de implantação de sistemas, transformação digital e projetos de compliance trabalhista.
  • Desenvolver estudos, relatórios gerenciais e análises estratégicas para suporte à tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Promover a padronização, documentação e melhoria contínua dos processos de Administração de Pessoal.


Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em administração de ponto eletrônico com operações de grande porte, preferencialmente com mais de 1.000 colaboradores.
  • Vivência na análise de dados e no desenvolvimento de indicadores, utilizando Excel Avançado, Power BI e/ou Looker Studio
  • Conhecimento de legislação trabalhista.
  • Experiência em integrações sistêmicas, validação de dados e parametrização de sistemas.
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Diferencial experiência com o sistema ADP.


Informações Adicionais

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Benefícios oferecidos: assistência médica, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio com academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e 20% de desconto em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.


Que tal fazer parte dessa jornada?

Venha crescer com a AutoZone e impulsionar o futuro da sua carreira!

title: Head of Business Development Americas
description:

The executive will play a central role in defining the company’s growth strategy, identifying new opportunities and building long-term relationships with clients, partners, investors, financial institutions, regulatory authorities and other relevant stakeholders.


The position involves close interaction with the company’s global executive leadership and cross-functional teams throughout the entire project value chain.

  • Define and execute the Business Development strategy for Americas, aligned with the company’s global objectives.
  • Originate and evaluate new renewable energy and infrastructure opportunities, including greenfield developments, partnerships and potential acquisitions.
  • Identify prospective clients and offtakers and support the origination and negotiation of Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs).

  • Lead project development activities, including opportunity assessment, commercial structuring, bid preparation, negotiations and investment decision processes.

  • Assess commercial, regulatory, technical and financial risks and ensure they are appropriately reflected in business cases and financial models.
  • Support project acquisitions, strategic partnerships, tender processes and other growth initiatives.
  • Represent the company in relevant business forums, institutional meetings and industry events.

Qualifications and experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, Law or another relevant field.

  • Strong track record in Business Development within the energy or infrastructure sectors.
  • Experience working in multinational companies and complex matrix organizations.
  • English and Spanish are required.
  • Availability for business travel.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial and commercially minded executive who combines strategic perspective with the ability to deliver results.


  • Strong business judgment and ability to identify value-creating opportunities.

  • Excellent negotiation, communication and influencing skills.
  • Ability to navigate complex commercial and institutional environments.
  • Collaborative leadership across functions, cultures and geographies.

Why join?


The successful candidate will operate with broad exposure to global leadership and will have the opportunity to shape the company’s long-term positioning and expansion in America´s market.

This recruitment process is being conducted on a confidential basis. Additional information about the company and the position will be shared with selected candidates during the process.

We welcome applications from qualified professionals of all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive and diverse selection process.

title: Gerente de Customer Experience
description:
Gerente de Customer Experience (CX)


Modelo de contratação: CLT ou PJ · Remuneração: Base + bônus por performance · Área: Customer Experience / Operações


Sobre a oportunidade

Plataforma de assinatura de conteúdo em fase de expansão busca um Gerente de CX para liderar a operação de atendimento a criadores e assinantes. O foco da posição não é apagar incêndios no dia a dia, e sim estruturar uma operação previsível: escala 24/7 bem dimensionada, qualidade medida com critério, autoatendimento que realmente resolve e uma leitura de dados que transforma o volume de tickets em decisão de produto.

É uma posição de gestão com mão na massa. A operação envolve dois públicos com necessidades bem diferentes, criadores, que dependem da plataforma como fonte de renda, e assinantes, que esperam resposta rápida e discrição, e temas sensíveis como pagamentos, saques, verificação de identidade, reembolsos e disputas.


Responsabilidades

• Liderar a operação de atendimento multicanal (chat, e-mail, redes e canais internos), com escala 24/7 dimensionada por curva de demanda.

• Gerir supervisores e agentes: contratação, treinamento, plano de desenvolvimento, feedback e gestão de performance individual.

• Definir e acompanhar SLAs de primeira resposta e resolução, além de indicadores de satisfação, reincidência e backlog.

• Estruturar e operar o programa de monitoria de qualidade: rubrica de avaliação, amostragem, calibração entre avaliadores e ciclo de feedback com os agentes.

• Reduzir volume de contato na origem — mapear os motivos recorrentes de ticket e levar as causas raiz para produto, tecnologia e financeiro com evidência de dados.

• Expandir autoatendimento e automação: central de ajuda, fluxos de bot, triagem assistida por IA e uso de IA como copiloto do agente, sempre medindo taxa de contenção e impacto na satisfação.

• Governar a configuração das ferramentas de atendimento (regras de automação, macros, formulários, taxonomia de classificação) para garantir dado confiável.

• Atuar como ponte com as áreas de risco, pagamentos, compliance e jurídico nos casos críticos, com trilha de escalonamento clara e definida.

• Produzir a leitura gerencial da operação: relatórios recorrentes de performance, capacidade e riscos, com recomendação — não só número.

• Construir o orçamento e o planejamento de headcount da área, defendendo custo por atendimento e retorno das iniciativas.


Perfil desejado

• Experiência em gestão de operações de CX, suporte ou relacionamento em ambiente digital, com equipe própria e volume alto.

• Vivência em operação com escala estendida ou 24/7 e dimensionamento por demanda.

• Domínio de indicadores de atendimento (SLA, CSAT, FCR, tempo médio de resposta e atendimento, reincidência, taxa de autoatendimento) e capacidade de sustentar decisão com dado.

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de atendimento (Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk ou similares), incluindo configuração de automações e relatórios.

• Repertório em automação e IA aplicada a atendimento, com visão crítica sobre onde automatizar e onde manter o humano.

• Confortável com temas sensíveis: conteúdo adulto, pagamentos, fraude, verificação de identidade e privacidade de dados.

• Capacidade de desenvolver gente — a operação melhora pela qualidade da liderança intermediária, não por controle centralizado.

• Diferenciais: experiência em creator economy, marketplaces ou fintech; conhecimento de chargeback e prevenção a fraude; SQL ou ferramentas de BI; espanhol ou inglês.


O que consideramos sucesso

Uma operação que sustenta o crescimento da plataforma sem crescer na mesma proporção. Os indicadores centrais da posição são o cumprimento consistente do SLA de resposta e resolução, a satisfação de criadores e assinantes, a taxa de autoatendimento e a redução de contatos evitáveis por causa raiz resolvida. Também avaliamos a maturidade do time: turnover baixo, monitoria calibrada e supervisores capazes de conduzir a operação com autonomia.


Remuneração

• Salário base compatível com a função e com o nível de senioridade.

• Bônus por performance atrelado aos indicadores da operação (SLA, satisfação, autoatendimento e eficiência de custo por atendimento).

JD Industrials, a subsidiary of JD Group, focuses on industrial supply chain technologies and services, with a market capitalization of approximately $5 billion.Our business is to support the development of enterprises from the industrial manufacturing industry through the integrated model of "supply chain + technology + service", and create a B to B procurement platform for industrial products. title: Sales Director, LATAM (Brazil)
description:
Sales Director, LATAM (Brazil)

Reports To: Head Of Media Sales & Service, LATAM

Location: Brazil, Remote (São Paulo)


About us

Broadsign is a leading programmatic ad tech company on a mission to make buying, selling, and delivering out-of-home media easier than ever. Our platform powers the world’s most successful OOH and retail media businesses while enabling agencies and brands to seamlessly plan and execute dynamic OOH campaigns across the globe. Come light up the world as a Sales Director.


Position Summary

Your day-to-day will vary but your mission is simple; as a key member of our Programmatic Team, you will be taking full responsibility for business development activities by educating buyers on the new opportunities brought forth by our products. Your patch will consist of media buyers from agencies, brands and DSP partners. You’ll put your sales experience to use by determining client needs and recommending optimal programmatic DOOH proposals and supporting agency-wide agreements.


Of course, if this role speaks to you, you’re someone who has;

  • 5-10 years sales experience in the media world; you understand agencies and what advertisers care about
  • Proven understanding of the digital programmatic world and/or the programmatic digital out-of-home ecosystem
  • Interest in engaging with new buyers by introducing them to the benefits of programmatic DOOH and the innovative advertising opportunities via the Broadsign programmatic stack
  • Excellent presentation skills - you know how to craft a pitch
  • Strong organisational skills
  • You have the ability to manage multiple tasks and perform well under pressure
  • Great communication and collaborative approach with teammates
  • This is a primarily remote role; however, we believe face-to-face connection drives the best results. You will be expected to make a best-effort approach to conducting in-person client meetings. To support your success, you will have full access to WeWork spaces.
  • Travel will primarily be within Brazil for client meetings, with occasional travel throughout LATAM for industry and company events.
  • This role requires professional fluency in English and Portuguese; proficiency in Spanish is highly advantageous.


What we bring to the table

  • Health & Dental Insurance: Supplemental private medical and dental coverage for you and your dependents. You’ll also have access to unlimited online mental health support through BetterHelp for you and your family.
  • Wellness & Remote Fund: R$ 3,000 annual flexible budget for home office, wellness, or internet expenses
  • Paid Time Off: Statutory 30 calendar days of paid rest after 12 months, plus the mandatory 1/3 vacation bonus, 5 "floater" days, 2 paid volunteer days, and 3 paid training days per year!
  • Daycare Assistance: Monthly financial support/reimbursement for early-childhood daycare (Auxílio-Creche )
  • Family Support: Parental leave salary supplement.
  • Growth Opportunities: Training & development opportunities with a yearly budget to support professional growth.


At Broadsign, we value the varied social identities that make up our community. We recognize talent comes in different forms and encourage applications that reflect different backgrounds and experiences. Our promise is to be an inclusive employer and partner, open to learning, with thoughtful strategies and practices that amplify the different voices of our industry.

title: Analista Senior de Remuneração & Benefícios (Modelo Presencial)
description:
O Analista Sênior/Especialista de Remuneração e Benefícios é responsável pela execução técnica, administração e excelência operacional da estratégia de Recompensas Totais (Total Rewards) nas operações locais do país. Reportando-se diretamente ao Gerente de C&B do país, este profissional garante que todas as diretrizes corporativas da Matriz sejam adequadamente localizadas e implementadas. O foco principal da posição é manter a competitividade de mercado e a equidade interna por meio de análises robustas de remuneração e gestão abrangente de benefícios. Como colaborador sênior, atua como especialista em conformidade trabalhista local, coordenação de corretoras de benefícios e gestão operacional de benefícios.


RESPONSABILIDADES:


Remuneração:

  • Implementação de Diretrizes: Auxiliar na implantação das diretrizes globais de C&B da matriz por meio da preparação de materiais de comunicação locais e da explicação dos objetivos técnicos às partes interessadas internas.
  • Suporte Técnico: Fornecer orientação técnica especializada à equipe local de RH Generalista com relação às estruturas salariais, elegibilidade de benefícios e políticas de recompensa.
  • Execução de Projetos: Apoiar o desenho e liderar a implementação de ponta a ponta de projetos de C&B específicos do país, garantindo que atendam às necessidades e prazos locais do negócio.
  • Manutenção de Políticas: Auxiliar na revisão periódica e atualização das políticas locais de Remuneração e Benefícios para garantir que permaneçam relevantes e alinhadas aos padrões corporativos.
  • Modelagem de Remuneração: Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a implementação operacional de estruturas de salário-base e modelos de remuneração variável (Incentivos de Curto Prazo/Incentivos de Vendas).
  • Análise Organizacional: Realizar estudos analíticos relacionados à estrutura organizacional local e ao planejamento de carreira, fornecendo insights baseados em dados para apoiar o crescimento do negócio.
  • Administração de Programas: Apoiar o desenho e a administração de programas locais de reconhecimento e retenção voltados para talentos de alto potencial.
  • Conformidade Legal: Garantir que todas as iniciativas de C&B operem em estrita conformidade com as leis trabalhistas locais, regulamentações tributárias e requisitos obrigatórios de seguridade social.
  • Gestão de Fornecedores: Apoiar a área de compras na negociação com fornecedores locais de benefícios (seguros, saúde, previdência) e monitorar o desempenho dos fornecedores em relação aos SLAs.
  • Gestão de Pesquisas: Coordenar a participação em pesquisas salariais locais (Mercer, Willis Towers Watson etc.) e analisar os resultados para recomendar melhorias de processo ou estrutura.
  • Avaliação de Cargos: Auxiliar na criação de descrições de cargos locais e realizar classificações de posições utilizando metodologias corporativas estabelecidas (IPE Mercer).
  • Suporte aos Ciclos: Administrar os aspectos operacionais dos ciclos anuais de mérito, promoções e pagamentos de bônus, incluindo monitoramento rigoroso do orçamento.
  • Relatórios de KPI: Monitorar e reportar os Indicadores-Chave de Desempenho (KPIs) locais de C&B, sugerindo ações corretivas ou iniciativas para melhorar as métricas de RH.


Benefícios:

  • Administração de Programas: Gerenciar todo o ciclo de vida dos programas locais de benefícios, incluindo assistência médica privada, seguro de vida, cobertura por invalidez e fundos locais de previdência/previdência complementar.
  • Apoio na gestão de Fornecedores: Coordenar com corretores de seguros e fornecedores de benefícios para garantir que os níveis de serviço sejam atendidos e participar da avaliação técnica dos fornecedores durante processos de concorrência.
  • Controle Orçamentário: Monitorar os gastos com benefícios em comparação ao orçamento local, identificando desvios e recomendando iniciativas de controle de custos sem comprometer a qualidade.
  • Integridade dos Dados: Manter registros e documentação de benefícios de forma meticulosa, garantindo que o HRIS (Sistema de Informação de Recursos Humanos) esteja sincronizado com as bases de dados dos fornecedores.
  • Auditoria e Conciliação: Realizar conciliações mensais das faturas de benefícios com os registros da folha de pagamento para garantir pagamentos corretos e evitar cobranças indevidas.
  • Monitoramento de SLA: Monitorar o desempenho dos fornecedores de benefícios em relação aos Acordos de Nível de Serviço (SLAs) acordados, escalando falhas persistentes de serviço para o Gerente de RH.


REQUISITOS:

• Formação Superior em administração de Empresas ou Afins

• Excel avançado (PROCV/VLOOKUP, Tabelas Dinâmicas e fórmulas complexas).

• Experiência com pesquisas salariais de mercado, preferencialmente Mercer.

• Inglês Avançado

100% presencial no Morumbi/SP
