title: HRBP
description:
About Us

JD.com is building the world's most trusted technology and supply chain ecosystem. From our innovative roots in China, we have grown into a NASDAQ-listed, Fortune 44 global enterprise serving over 700 million active customers. Powered by advanced logistics networks, innovative technology, and a commitment to integrity, our business spans retail, logistics, technology, and real estate, dedicated to creating a smarter, faster, and more connected way of life. Through our digital intelligent cross-border supply chain and global logistics network, we continue to expand our international footprint, with operations across China, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Brazil. You will join JD's overseas HR team, where we value collaboration, encourage ownership, and are committed to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.


Position Overview

As the HRBP in Brazil, you will serve as the strategic HR partner for JD's Brazil business team, deeply understanding business needs and providing comprehensive HR solutions for Brazilian operations, covering talent acquisition, organizational development, employee relations, and compliance management. Location: São Paulo, Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Partnership: Partner with business leadership to understand business priorities and provide strategic HR support to enhance organizational performance.
  • Talent Management: Lead talent management processes, including performance reviews, succession planning, and leadership development programs.
  • Recruitment Strategy: Develop and implement effective recruitment strategies to meet JD's staffing needs across business lines in Brazil.
  • Employee Relations: Manage employee relations, ensure a positive work environment, and address performance or behavioral issues in compliance with Brazilian labor law (CLT).
  • Change Management: Support organizational change and transformation initiatives aligned with JD's global vision.
  • Compliance & Benefits: Advise on compensation, benefits, and HR policies, ensuring full compliance with Brazilian Consolidation of Labor Laws (CLT), including severance regulations (FGTS), vacation and 13th-month salary provisions, occupational health and safety standards (NR regulations), and applicable federal labor regulations.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Utilize HR data and analytics to continuously improve HR programs and processes.
  • Culture Building: Promote employee engagement, diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) to strengthen JD's work culture.


Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of HR Business Partner experience; background in cross-border e-commerce, retail, supply chain, or internet industry is preferred.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both verbally and in writing; proficiency in Portuguese is highly preferred. Strong negotiation skills and the ability to navigate a global corporate structure.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiar with the talent landscape and operational characteristics of the Brazilian and Latin American market, with strong business acumen.
  • Core Competencies: Solid experience in performance management, talent development, employee relations, and organizational development.
  • Stakeholder Management: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Legal Expertise: Familiarity with Brazilian labor laws, including CLT, FGTS, INSS social security regulations, 13th-month salary (décimo terceiro) provisions, workplace health and safety norms (NR), and the Brazilian Labor Reform (Lei 13.467/2017). Knowledge of Brazilian union negotiations (acordos coletivos) is a plus.


What We Offer

Joining JD means becoming part of a company that seamlessly integrates talent, innovation, and impact. We offer: a competitive market compensation package (including expatriate allowances and benefits), comprehensive commercial insurance and medical coverage in Brazil, broad career development pathways and global project opportunities, an inclusive and diverse work culture where your voice will be heard, and a comprehensive expatriate support system for relocation and cross-cultural adaptation.

JD is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Contrato: Modelo PJ, utilizado para cargos gerenciais e de liderança, com pagamentos mensais fixos de R$ 10.000,00 (dez mil reais).

title: Especialista financeiro de contratos sênior
description:
Sobre nós


Somos a Forvis Mazars, com mais de 80 anos de expertise global e mais de 20 anos de presença no Brasil. Presente em mais de 100 países, nossos colaboradores estão a postos para apoiar sua empresa com serviços de Auditoria, Consultoria e BPO reconhecidos pelo mercado no Brasil e no mundo.

title: Consultor de Negócios Sênior
description:
O desafio

Você vai conduzir, no dia a dia, o diagnóstico ponta a ponta do ciclo Order-to-Cash no seguimento de educação, desde a matrícula até o fechamento contábil, investigando por evidências os processos, controles e a governança que contribuíram para apontamentos de auditoria externa. O trabalho cobre um ambiente multi-marcas e multi-BUs, com handoffs complexos entre CSC, Faturamento e Contabilidade, e inclui o ciclo de financiamentos estudantis (FIES e PAI/CREDIN). Você transforma os achados em matriz de causas-raiz e roadmap priorizado, com reporte ao Gerente de Negócios.


O que você vai fazer

  • Conduzir entrevistas com pontos focais e mapear o macroprocesso do OTC por BU e marca, identificando gatilhos de receita, desvios de execução, retrabalhos e processos informais que ocorrem em paralelo
  • Catalogar falhas ativas de controle, exceções de faturamento e pontos de pressão no fechamento contábil mensal, validando os achados em workshops com os atores operacionais
  • Desenhar e executar testes de estresse orientados por evidências (ex.: transações com descontos retroativos e movimentações fora das regras) para comprovar quebras de processo e de controle
  • Mapear papéis, alçadas e handoffs entre as áreas do ciclo de receita, estruturando matriz RACI, fóruns de decisão, SLAs, regras de escalonamento e ritos de acompanhamento
  • No ciclo dos financiamentos (FIES e PAI/CREDIN): mapear concessão, aditamentos, repasses e baixas, levantar regras de negócio e critérios de composição, e validar os saldos frente às evidências junto à governança
  • Consolidar gaps, riscos e causas-raiz em matriz única priorizada, indicando quick wins, controles compensatórios e medidas transitórias
  • Desdobrar as causas-raiz em iniciativas e estruturar o roadmap em ondas, com responsáveis, dependências e critérios de aceite, co-facilitando os fóruns executivos de validação

O que procuramos

  • Experiência, com pelo menos 2 em consultoria estratégica ou de gestão, ou em áreas de processos, controles internos, auditoria ou governança corporativa
  • Vivência comprovada em mapeamento de processos ponta a ponta, matriz de riscos e controles, segregação de funções e redesenho de rotinas financeiras (receita, faturamento, contas a receber)
  • Familiaridade com o ciclo Order-to-Cash e com rotinas de fechamento contábil; conhecimento de ERP (Protheus é diferencial)
  • Excel avançado e PowerPoint executivo: transformar evidência em narrativa clara para Diretoria e C-Level
  • Postura executiva e capacidade de conduzir entrevistas e workshops com múltiplas áreas
  • Experiência no setor de educação ou em operações B2C de alta recorrência é diferencial
  • Inglês avançado

Contratação: PJ + benefícios (plano médico, odontológico, alimentação, seguro de vida, bem - estar)

Modelo Híbrido: São Paulo - Capital.

title: Financial Planning and Analysis Manager
description:
This role has overall responsibility for business forecasts and evaluation of current & future business activities/opportunities.


The Financial Planning and Reporting Manager works closely with:

  • With territory marketing, production, research and ad sales teams as the point of contact for business forecasting, channel and product financial performance analysis, commercial profit reporting;
  • Financial Controllers as an interface between the actual and forecast results as well as support with monthly close/reporting activity;


Management Reporting

  • Co-ordinates and manages in-territory annual and monthly management review process vs budget & forecast for P & L and balance-sheet items.
  • Assess the organizational performance against budget and strategy and provide challenge and insight into financial performance to enable appropriate decisions to be made on future performance and growth
  • Provides commentaries, analysis and insight on key trends , initiatives and risks and opportunities at Territory level for input to the Management pack.
  • Provides title P&L analysis and participants reporting


Planning, Budgeting and Forecasting

  • Manage the forecast and plan review and approval process with hub and corporate
  • Coordinate and prepare the draft annual budget (revenue, cost and overhead), and additionally for the quarterly forecast
  • Co-ordinate timely input of financial and business drivers into the global 3 year plan
  • Identify and agree KPIs which track performance against Business Plans.
  • Translates market conditions into the financial forecast
  • Tests alternative high level business scenarios and run sensitivity analysis and assess risks and opportunities with the territories and hub management team
  • Partner with the Sales/Mktg/Operations teams to provide financial insight
  • Prepare and review the cash forecast
  • Prepare the supporting analysis of the flash reporting and monthly forecasts
  • Liaise with Sales to develop customer level budgets and forecasts
  • Support managers to develop tactical, operational and capital plans and initiatives to deliver targets


Projects, Analysis and Continuous Improvement

  • Optimize tools and systems to provide critical financial and operational information and make actionable recommendations on strategy and operations
  • Identify and ensure implementation of process improvements to continually improve performance
  • Analyses commercial proposals to support decision-making, including discount structures, promotions analysis, customer profitability analysis
  • Actively participate as part of ad-hoc global teams to develop enhanced tools & processes followed by tactical implementation locally


Global Finance team

  • Works with, supports, and is supported by FP&A Managers, Financial Controllers, Business Analysts, Finance Directors and Home Office members of the global team
  • Builds an environment based on trust, respect, teamwork, initiative and innovation

Strong knowledge of:

  • US GAAP,and how to apply it, and when applicable to business results and forecasts.
  • Tools, approaches, roles, techniques, processes and/or procedures needed to:
  • Establish and monitor budgets.
  • Explore and evaluate alternative financial scenarios and results.
  • Analyze a product, customer, process, or project in terms of cost and benefits.
  • Create and maintain accurate and thorough financial reports.
  • Recognize, anticipate, and resolve organization, operations or process problems.


Strong ability to:

  • Effectively communicate across the Business and Finance organization with strong English oral and written skills
  • Co-ordinate and own a complex process through clear communication and organization of disparate participants to deliver a timely and effective output
  • Analysis of underlying financial and non financial data to provide an insight into the performance to enable the appropriate decisions to be made
  • Provide clear, understandable and meaningful insights in to the business to support the management to making informed business decisions
  • Work in a fast moving and changing environment, and manage multiple priorities.
  • Establish collaborative and productive relationships with clients, vendors and peers to facilitate excellent business support.
  • Read, interpret and draw accurate conclusions from financial and numerical material.
  • Work with and manipulate multiple data sources to generate useful and insightful data.
  • Create, implement, evaluate and enhance internal control processes.


Other:

  • Experience of working in an international organization and in the entertainment sector
  • Continually seeks to exceed expectations through self and team development.
  • Ability to forge strong, international relationships with diverse teams.
  • Be comfortable with ambiguity in a dynamic, changing, commercial environment
  • Demonstrate true learning agility
  • Build effective teams, understanding the importance of team culture & values.
  • Act collaboratively at all times, and build successful partner relationships.

title: Partner Management Manager (Commercial Focus)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Partner Management Manager to lead strategic partnerships and drive sustainable business growth. This role requires a strong commercial mindset, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and proven experience navigating complex and long sales cycles with senior decision-makers.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, negotiating, and managing high-impact partnerships while owning the full partnership lifecycle—from opportunity identification and deal structuring through implementation, growth, and long-term relationship management.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires close collaboration with Operations, Product, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and senior leadership teams.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Partnership Development

  • Identify, evaluate, and develop strategic partnership opportunities aligned with company growth objectives.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key external stakeholders, including C-level executives and senior decision-makers.
  • Develop partnership strategies that create long-term commercial value and competitive advantage.
  • Conduct market analysis to identify emerging trends, white spaces, and new business opportunities.

Commercial Negotiation & Deal Management

  • Lead complex commercial negotiations involving multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and sophisticated deal structures.
  • Own the end-to-end partnership process, from prospecting and opportunity qualification to contract execution and post-launch growth.
  • Structure and negotiate commercial agreements, pricing models, revenue-sharing frameworks, and strategic collaboration terms.
  • Manage contract renewals, renegotiations, and expansion opportunities to maximize partner lifetime value.
  • Drive alignment among internal and external stakeholders throughout the negotiation process.

Partner Growth & Account Management

  • Develop strategic account plans for key partners to drive revenue growth and deepen relationships.
  • Monitor partnership performance through KPIs, business reviews, and growth initiatives.
  • Identify upselling, cross-selling, and expansion opportunities within existing partnerships.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with partners to ensure alignment, performance, and long-term success.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience in Business Development, Strategic Partnerships, Key Account Management, or Enterprise Sales.
  • Proven track record of managing complex sales and negotiation cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience negotiating high-value commercial agreements and strategic partnerships.
  • Strong experience managing executive-level relationships.
  • Excellent analytical and commercial acumen.

title: Gerente de Supply Chain Sr
description:
Será um parceiro estratégico de áreas como Comercial, Marketing, Finanças, Manufatura e stakeholders globais, liderando decisões baseadas em dados, gestão de riscos e construção de cenários para suportar o crescimento sustentável do negócio. Também é responsável por impulsionar a evolução da maturidade de Supply Chain, promovendo simplificação de processos, transformação digital, uso de analytics e inteligência artificial, melhoria contínua, desenvolvimento de pessoas e uma cultura de alta performance.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a cadeia de suprimentos end-to-end no Brasil, integrando planejamento de demanda e supply, S&OP/IBP, logística, customer service, comércio exterior e parceiros estratégicos, assegurando alinhamento com os objetivos de crescimento, rentabilidade e eficiência do negócio;
  • Conduzir e evoluir o processo de S&OP/IBP, conectando estratégia, plano financeiro, demanda, capacidade operacional e disponibilidade de produtos, com foco em decisões executivas baseadas em cenários, riscos, oportunidades e trade-offs entre serviço, custo, margem e capital de giro;
  • Fortalecer a governança de execução operacional, assegurando a conexão entre o plano de S&OP/IBP e a execução de curto prazo, com foco na antecipação de riscos, priorização de decisões operacionais e correção rápida de desvios que impactem nível de serviço, disponibilidade de produtos, estoques e performance do negócio;
  • Elevar a maturidade do planejamento por meio da melhoria contínua de forecast accuracy, forecast bias, aderência ao plano, gestão de portfólio e visibilidade de demanda, assegurando maior previsibilidade para a operação e para o negócio;
  • Definir e implementar políticas de estoque e estratégias de supply que garantam o equilíbrio entre disponibilidade de produtos, nível de serviço, capital de giro, riscos de obsolescência e eficiência operacional;
  • Liderar as operações logísticas de armazenagem, transporte e distribuição, assegurando excelência de serviço, produtividade, eficiência de custos, qualidade operacional, segurança, compliance e escalabilidade da operação;
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver a rede de parceiros logísticos, operadores, transportadoras e fornecedores estratégicos, garantindo performance, melhoria contínua, governança contratual e alinhamento aos padrões da companhia;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de distribuição e atendimento alinhadas às necessidades dos diferentes canais, clientes e regiões, contribuindo para uma experiência de cliente mais consistente, eficiente e orientada ao crescimento;
  • Liderar a agenda de Customer Service, garantindo integração com Comercial, Finanças, Logística e Planejamento, com foco em nível de serviço, ciclo do pedido, produtividade, qualidade do atendimento e excelência na jornada order-to-cash;
  • Atuar de forma próxima às áreas Comercial, Marketing, Finanças, Manufatura, Compras e stakeholders globais, influenciando decisões e assegurando alinhamento multifuncional nas prioridades de Supply Chain;
  • Gerenciar as operações de comércio exterior, assegurando fluidez no abastecimento internacional, conformidade regulatória, gestão de riscos, eficiência de custos e alinhamento com fornecedores, afiliadas e parceiros globais;
  • Liderar a transformação digital da área de Supply Chain, incorporando dados, automação, analytics e inteligência artificial como alavancas para simplificar processos, aumentar produtividade, antecipar riscos e melhorar a tomada de decisão operacional e estratégica;
  • Definir, acompanhar e comunicar indicadores-chave de performance da área, incluindo nível de serviço, OTIF, CFR, forecast accuracy, bias, aderência ao plano, inventário, capital de giro, custos logísticos, produtividade e performance de parceiros;
  • Gerir o orçamento da área e contribuir diretamente para a melhoria dos resultados financeiros, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos, otimização de working capital, produtividade e geração de valor para o negócio;
  • Promover uma cultura de melhoria contínua, disciplina de execução, colaboração multifuncional, orientação ao cliente, segurança, compliance e sustentabilidade nas operações de Supply Chain.
  • Liderar, desenvolver e engajar times multidisciplinares, fortalecendo capacidades técnicas e comportamentais, sucessão, autonomia, accountability e cultura de alta performance.

title: Inside Sales Manager
description:
Kaspersky has been protecting individuals and corporate clients all over the world from cyber threats for 29 years.


We have 400 million unique users, 270 000 corporate clients, 517 products, 1100 technological patents and 34 offices around the world. Today our team has more than 5 500 top level experts, all of them regular people with their own talents and hobbies.


Together we protect the world from cyber threats.


Join us to become part of an exceptional team, while remaining yourself and using your skills to keep us growing and evolving.


Kaspersky is looking for an Inside Sales Manager to drive SMB sales growth in Brazil by developing relationships with customers and channel partners and identifying new business opportunities. This role is responsible for managing sales pipelines, supporting partners throughout the sales cycle, positioning Kaspersky solutions and value proposition, and helping to win deals against the competition.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Consistently meet or exceed sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory;
  • Drive SMB sales through channel partners, including new business, renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities;
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with partners and SMB customers;
  • Identify, assess and develop new business opportunities and prospective customers;

  • Promote and clearly articulate Kaspersky’s value proposition and competitive advantages to partners and customers;
  • Recruit, train and enable partners to effectively position and sell Kaspersky solutions;
  • Balance farming and hunting activities by developing existing accounts while acquiring new customers;
  • Conduct regular follow-ups and coordinate with partners to support deal progression and increase win rates;
  • Work closely with Sales, Channel and Marketing teams on joint sales and marketing activities;
  • Support webinars, events, product demonstrations and other activities aimed at generating demand and business opportunities;
  • Maintain accurate documentation of sales activities, partner engagements and opportunities.


Required Experience, Skills and Competencies:


  • 5–8 years of experience in Sales, Account Management or Business Development within the technology industry;
  • Strong understanding of the full sales cycle and experience managing sales pipelines and business opportunities;
  • Experience selling technology solutions, services or complex projects based on customer needs and business value;
  • Experience in both new business development and existing account management;
  • Experience working with customers and channel partners;

title: Analista de Assuntos Regulatórios Sr
description:
Na Dori | Ferrara, Ferrero, Fox’s Burton’s Companies e The Fine Biscuits Company, somos reconhecidos e amados por pessoas de todas as gerações pela alegria que compartilhamos com elas – uma alegria feita pelas nossas pessoas. Junte-se a nós e descubra um mundo cheio de possibilidades, onde sua paixão encontrará o seu lugar.


A Dori | Ferrara é uma das maiores empresas de doces e snacks do Brasil! Há mais de seis décadas, com um time de mais de 3000 colaboradores, produzimos produtos que acompanham gerações e fazem parte da história e das lembranças de milhões de famílias, com marcas icônicas como Gomets®, Yogurte 100®, Pettiz® e Disqueti®.


Em 2023, iniciamos um novo capítulo ao nos tornarmos parte da Ferrara Candy Company, líder número 1 em balas e gomas nos Estados Unidos, com marcas mundialmente conhecidas como NERDS®, Brach’s®, Jelly Belly®, SweeTARTS®, Laffy Taffy®, and Trolli®. E, na França, a Carambar & Co conquistou gerações de clientes fiéis graças ao apelo atemporal de marcas icônicas de doces e chocolates, como Carambar, Lutti, Krema, Poulain, Vichy e Terry’s.


Com essa união, somos mais de 9.000 colaboradores e uma rede com mais de 30 unidades, garantindo nossa presença global.


Analista de Assuntos Regulatórios Sr


O Analista de Assuntos Regulatórios Sr será responsável por assegurar a conformidade regulatória relacionada a ingredientes, formulações e rotulagem, atuando de forma estratégica junto às áreas de operações e contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos, suporte às decisões de negócio e viabilização da inovação em conformidade com a legislação aplicável.


Localidade: São Paulo - SP


Reporta a: Gerente Sr de Qualidade


Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido


Contamos com você para:

  • Pesquisar e analisar, de forma independente, requisitos regulatórios relacionados a ingredientes/aditivos, padrões de identidade, rotulagem e comprovação de claims, utilizando ferramentas e sistemas internos e externos;
  • Fornecer recomendações regulatórias proativas e baseadas em risco sobre ingredientes, formulações e rotulagem para stakeholders multifuncionais em projetos complexos de comercialização;
  • Elaborar e validar, de forma independente, os textos técnicos de rotulagem, aplicando regulamentações vigentes e princípios e padrões de nutrição e ciência dos alimentos;
  • Colaborar com áreas multifuncionais na revisão de conteúdos de rótulos, garantindo acuracidade das informações e recomendando ajustes quando necessário;
  • Revisar, registrar e certificar matérias-primas e produtos acabados junto a órgãos certificadores;
  • Atuar em sinergia com as áreas e stakeholders parceiros, acompanhando regulamentações emergentes e avaliando impactos no portfólio de produtos e nos requisitos de rotulagem;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar processos internos, incluindo a criação de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POPs), treinamentos, suporte técnico a demandas de consumidores e participação em projetos especiais, incluindo visitas a unidades produtivas quando necessário.


Do que você precisa para fazer a diferença:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Alimentos, Química, Biologia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia na função em indústrias de alimentos e/ou de ingredientes;
  • Possuir forte conhecimento sobre matérias-primas (macro e micronutrientes), funcionalidade dos ingredientes, normas de identidade etc., no que se refere à rotulagem;
  • Conhecimento em SAP e Microsoft Suit;
  • Inglês ao nível avançado, com habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita, para contato com time global;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para Marília – SP e Rolândia – PR.


O que nós oferecemos:


Na Dori | Ferrara, nos orgulhamos de prover aos nossos colaboradores:


  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR)
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Dr Dori (telemedicina)
  • Seguro de vida
  • Totalpass
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Natal
  • Vale transporte
  • Descontos em produtos


Igualdade de Oportunidades


Temos orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e progressão de carreira. Para isso, as decisões e oportunidades de emprego na Dori | Ferrara serão baseadas no mérito, nas qualificações e nas habilidades, independentemente da raça, cor, credo, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade e expressão de gênero, estado civil ou união civil, nacionalidade, ascendência, cidadania, idade, condição de militar ou veterano, deficiência, informações genéticas, gravidez (parto ou condição médica relacionada) ou qualquer outra base proibida por lei.


A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Se receber qualquer mensagem solicitando pagamento ou dados de cartão de crédito, pedimos que não responda e entre em contato imediatamente com nossos canais oficiais de atendimento (redes sociais ou SAC ).


Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

title: Especialista de Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A) – Foco em Covenants Financeiros
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Objetivo da Posição

Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A), fechamento gerencial e gestão de indicadores financeiros, com forte atuação no acompanhamento e controle de covenants financeiros , endividamento corporativo e indicadores de alavancagem. Este (a) profissional será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade das informações financeiras, suportar a tomada de decisão da liderança e assegurar a aderência às obrigações financeiras e contratuais da companhia.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar o fechamento gerencial das concessões e holdings do grupo, assegurando a qualidade e consistência das informações financeiras.
  • Monitorar e controlar os covenants financeiros previstos em contratos de dívida, garantindo o cumprimento das obrigações contratuais e antecipando potenciais riscos de descumprimento.
  • Acompanhar indicadores financeiros relacionados ao endividamento e à alavancagem, incluindo Dívida Líquida, EBITDA, Dívida Líquida/EBITDA e cobertura de juros.
  • Elaborar análises de realizado versus orçamento e forecast, identificando desvios, causas e impactos no desempenho financeiro.
  • Consolidar informações financeiras de diferentes empresas e estruturas societárias do grupo.
  • Participar da elaboração, atualização e acompanhamento de forecasts mensais, projeções financeiras e análises de cenários.
  • Atuar no controle e acompanhamento de contratos de financiamento e demais instrumentos de dívida corporativa.
  • Desenvolver materiais gerenciais e apresentações executivas para reporte à alta liderança e suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Apoiar a validação de informações contábeis e financeiras relacionadas aos indicadores monitorados.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos financeiros, controles internos e modelos de análise.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A) , fechamento gerencial e consolidação financeira.
  • Vivência comprovada com controle e monitoramento de covenants financeiros , endividamento corporativo e indicadores de alavancagem.

title: Senior AI Solutions Sales
description:
On behalf of Huawei, a world-renowned it and communications company, we are looking for Senior AI Solutions Sales Specialist talents.


Please see the position details below:


We are hiring experienced local professionals in Brazil and Mexico to develop and win AI computing opportunities with large enterprise customers. This is a customer-facing solution sales role with strong pre-sales ownership: you will identify and qualify opportunities, lead technical discovery, shape the solution and competitive strategy, drive PoCs and tenders, and support the account team through commercial closure and handover.


Key Responsibilities

1. Opportunity Development & Account Shaping : Partner with account managers to build and qualify the AI computing pipeline. Identify customer priorities, use cases, stakeholders, decision criteria, budget and procurement path; convert early-stage needs into actionable opportunities and account plans.

2. Customer Discovery & Solution Architecture : Lead technical and business discovery workshops. Translate AI training, inference, HPC and enterprise workloads into end-to-end architectures covering compute, accelerators, cluster topology, storage, networking, operating systems, containers and hybrid-cloud integration. Define sizing, capacity, availability, security and expansion assumptions.

3. Technical Influence, Workshops & PoCs : Present solutions to C-level executives, technical decision-makers and architecture teams. Build customer-specific demonstrations, PoC plans and benchmark criteria; coordinate resources, track results and close technical gaps. Explain trade-offs in a clear, commercially relevant way.

4. Bid, Tender & Commercial Support : Own or contribute to RFI/RFP responses, solution blueprints, Bills of Materials (BoM), compliance matrices, Statements of Work and TCO/business-case inputs. Support public tenders and enterprise procurement, address technical objections and help the sales team position a competitive, executable offer.

5. Ecosystem & Competitive Strategy : Work with local system integrators, ISVs, cloud partners and data-center partners to complete the solution. Track competing AI and infrastructure platforms, customer incumbent environments and ecosystem dependencies; develop practical migration, interoperability and differentiation strategies.

6. Deal Closure & Handover : Stay engaged through negotiation and closure to protect solution scope and feasibility. After award, hand over the agreed architecture, assumptions, commitments, risks and PoC findings to delivery and support teams, and maintain continuity with the customer.


Job Requirements & Professional Knowledge:


• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical/Electronic Engineering or a related technical discipline.

• 8+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure, cloud, data-center solutions, solution architecture, pre-sales or technical solution sales; at least 5 years in a customer-facing role in the assigned local market.

• Demonstrated experience selling or designing AI computing, accelerated computing, HPC or large-scale server/platform solutions.

• Strong understanding of enterprise server platforms, CPU architectures (including x86 and ARM), AI accelerators/GPUs/NPUs, cluster design, storage and data-center networking.

• Working knowledge of AI workload fundamentals, including training vs. inference, distributed computing, model deployment, performance bottlenecks and the mainstream AI software ecosystem. Deep model-development or data-science coding expertise is not required.

• Hands-on familiarity with Linux and cloud-native infrastructure, including RHEL or equivalent enterprise Linux, Kubernetes/OpenShift or comparable container platforms, and hybrid-cloud integration patterns.

• Proven ability to lead technical discovery, solution sizing, customer presentations, PoCs, RFP/RFI responses, BoM development and TCO/business-case discussions.

• Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills. Able to work with business leaders, procurement teams and technical specialists without losing technical depth or commercial focus.

• Ability to work independently across a multi-country organization and travel within the assigned country/LATAM when customer engagements require it.

Você fará parte da área de Inteligência de Dados e IA (IDeIA), responsável pelas plataformas de dados utilizadas pelos times de produto da TOTVS.


Todos os dias, terabytes de dados de ERP passam por essas plataformas e sustentam projetos de dezenas de times internos. Do agronegócio ao varejo, da construção à saúde, esses dados apoiam a operação e a tomada de decisão de milhares de empresas brasileiras.

title: Analista de Relacionamento Pleno (Saúde)
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de Relacionamento com Profissionais de Saúde para ser um dos principais pontos de conexão entre a Starbem e nossa rede de médicos, psicólogos, nutricionistas e demais profissionais.Essa pessoa será responsável por acompanhar a jornada do profissional na Starbem, com foco em relacionamento, cadastro, documentação, regularização, vinculação ao CNES, mediação de divergências financeiras e organização das demandas relacionadas à rede profissional.Buscamos alguém organizado, comunicativo, resolutivo e com forte senso de responsabilidade, capaz de garantir uma experiência positiva para nossos profissionais e, ao mesmo tempo, manter nossa rede assistencial organizada e regular.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Analista de Relacionamento com Profissionais de Saúde, você terá um papel importante na gestão e experiência da nossa rede profissional, atuando nas seguintes frentes:

  • Relacionamento com profissionais: Ser o principal ponto de contato entre a Starbem e os profissionais de saúde, acolhendo dúvidas, solicitações e dificuldades e acompanhando cada demanda até sua resolução.
  • Cadastro e atualização de dados: Realizar, organizar e manter atualizado o cadastro dos profissionais, garantindo a qualidade e confiabilidade das informações pessoais, profissionais, bancárias e fiscais.
  • Gestão de documentos: Solicitar, conferir, organizar e acompanhar documentos profissionais, registros nos respectivos conselhos, especialidades e demais documentos necessários para atuação na plataforma.
  • Gestão do CNES: Acompanhar o cadastro, inclusão, atualização e vinculação dos profissionais ao CNES da Starbem, controlando pendências e garantindo a regularidade da rede assistencial.
  • Controle de regularidade cadastral: Manter acompanhamento dos profissionais com documentação pendente, vencida ou inconsistente, realizando os contatos necessários para sua regularização.
  • Onboarding de novos profissionais: Acompanhar a entrada dos profissionais na Starbem, garantindo a conclusão das etapas cadastrais, documentais e administrativas necessárias para sua vinculação à rede.
  • Mediação de divergências financeiras: Receber e acompanhar dúvidas ou inconsistências relacionadas aos pagamentos dos profissionais, como valores divergentes, consultas não contabilizadas, dados bancários, notas fiscais ou outras ocorrências.
  • Interface com o Financeiro: Organizar as informações necessárias e atuar como ponte entre o profissional e a área Financeira até a resolução das divergências identificadas.
  • Gestão de pendências: Manter controles estruturados das demandas em aberto, garantindo acompanhamento, retorno ao profissional e cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Comunicação com a rede: Apoiar comunicados sobre processos, políticas, documentação, pagamentos, treinamentos, eventos e outras iniciativas da Starbem.
  • Engajamento dos profissionais: Fortalecer o relacionamento com a rede, identificando oportunidades de melhoria da experiência e contribuindo para maior proximidade e retenção dos profissionais.
  • Indicadores da rede: Apoiar a construção e acompanhamento de indicadores como profissionais cadastrados, ativos, documentação regular, CNES, pendências, divergências financeiras, tempo de resolução e satisfação dos profissionais.
  • Melhoria contínua: Identificar problemas recorrentes na jornada dos profissionais e propor melhorias nos processos internos, contribuindo para uma experiência cada vez mais simples, organizada e eficiente.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Gestão em Saúde, Recursos Humanos, Enfermagem ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em atendimento, relacionamento, Customer Success, operações, credenciamento ou áreas administrativas.

  • Facilidade para relacionamento com diferentes perfis profissionais.

description:

Royal Enfield - About Us:

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955,a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India’s middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfields are engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It’s an approach the brand calls Pure Motorcycling.

Royal Enfield’s premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles. Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional

andinternational level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.

A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centers, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company’s worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield’s first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia.

Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH.NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY ’24, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 16,536 crores which is approximately USD 2.01 billion.

title: Talent & Recruitment Rockstar Wanted
description:
Talent & Recruitment Rockstar — Full-Cycle Hiring Lead

We are a fast-growing travel facilitation company processing thousands of applications per month across multiple destinations around the globe. We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Talent & Recruitment Rockstar to join our team.


The Role

We're looking for a fluent English speaking senior Talent & Recruitment Specialist to take full ownership of hiring as we grow. This is a build-from-the-ground-up opportunity: you'll design our recruitment processes and systems from scratch, not inherit someone else's playbook. You'll work directly with the founding team to understand hiring needs across advertising, payments, technology, and operations, and turn that into a repeatable pipeline that gets us the right people fast.


What You'll Do

• Own full-cycle recruiting end to end: defining roles, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing candidates

• Build and document scalable recruitment processes and systems suited to a lean, fast-moving startup

• Partner directly with founders and functional leads to translate business needs into hiring plans

• Develop sourcing strategies for both individual contributors and future key hires as the company scales

• Manage the candidate experience from first contact through offer and onboarding

• Track and report on hiring metrics, and continuously refine the process based on what's working


What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of experience in talent acquisition or recruitment, ideally including time at a startup or in a generalist/full-cycle capacity

• Track record of building recruitment processes rather than just operating within existing ones

• Comfortable working autonomously and directly with founders in a remote, distributed team

title: Senior Video Editor / Multimedia Designer
description:
About Boldr

Boldr is building the future of residential energy management. Our mission is to help homeowners connect and optimize the energy assets in their homes, reducing energy consumption and lowering utility bills. We are starting with the largest residential energy market in the U.S. — HVAC.


About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Video Editor to support teams across our company and help bring our products, features, and brand to life through high-quality video.


This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll work with multiple departments to create everything from product tutorials and onboarding content to feature announcements, product launches, and performance marketing ads.


Your work will have significant reach, supporting tens of thousands of end customers as well as our channel partners . We’re looking for someone who is comfortable taking projects from brief to finished product, can adapt their editing style to different audiences and objectives, and consistently delivers polished, professional work.


What You'll Do

  • Edit and produce high-quality video content for teams across the company.
  • Create product tutorials that clearly explain how our products and features work.
  • Produce customer onboarding videos and educational content.
  • Create videos supporting new feature releases and product announcements .
  • Develop launch content for new product releases and campaigns .
  • Edit and produce video ads for performance marketing across paid media channels.
  • Create video content for our customers, channel partners, sales teams, marketing teams, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Turn briefs, scripts, screen recordings, product footage, voiceovers, and other raw assets into engaging finished videos.
  • Add titles, captions, transitions, music, sound effects, and other production elements where appropriate.
  • Maintain a consistent level of quality and brand presentation across different types of video content.
  • Manage multiple video projects and priorities across different departments.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand project objectives, incorporate feedback, and deliver content that meets both creative and business goals.


Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of professional video editing experience.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating a range of high-quality video editing work.
  • Advanced proficiency with professional video editing software.
  • Strong working knowledge of AI-powered video editing and creative tools , with the ability to use AI to improve editing workflows, accelerate production, generate or enhance creative assets, and increase overall output without compromising quality.
  • Strong understanding of editing fundamentals including pacing, storytelling, composition, audio, transitions, and visual hierarchy.
  • Ability to adapt your editing style across educational, product, marketing, and advertising content.
  • Strong attention to detail and a high standard for production quality.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment and managing multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Professional or native-level English proficiency. All communication and content will be in English.


Bonus skills

We’d especially like to hear from candidates who also have experience with:

  • Graphic design
  • Motion graphics and animation
  • Videography and video production
  • Creating content for physical products
  • Performance marketing and paid social video creative
  • Product-focused or SaaS-style educational content


What Success Looks Like

You’ll become a trusted creative partner to teams across the company, capable of quickly understanding what a video needs to accomplish and translating that objective into clear, engaging, polished content.


Your work will help customers understand our products, help partners sell and support them, help new users get started, and help our marketing teams reach new audiences.


Remote Work

This is a fully remote position but you may be required to go to the office in São Paulo a couple of times a month . You should be comfortable working independently, communicating asynchronously, managing deadlines, and collaborating with team members across different functions.



How to Apply


Please submit:

  • Your CV or resume.
  • A portfolio or reel showcasing your video editing work linked in your CV or resume.


Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.


We’re particularly interested in seeing examples of product videos, tutorials, advertisements, motion graphics, launch content, or other work that demonstrates your ability to communicate clearly through video.

title: 3D/Catia Expert
description:
Project Description:

Automotive. German OEM. The project is responsible for cross-brand platform capabilities and foundational technologies in the field of vehicle electronics and softwar. Ensure the development of electric and electronic hardware solutions with wellbalanced performance steps, delivering with quality and with modular scalability to support the transition to platform all company brands


Responsibilities:

  • Expert in 3D design and digital product development using CATIA (or comparable CAD tools), responsible for creating, managing, and optimizing mechanical and electromechanical designs as well as installation concepts in a 3D environment (e.g., ECUs, harness integration, packaging).
  • Create and maintain 3D models and assemblies for components and systems (e.g.,
  • ECUs, housings, brackets, harness routing).
  • Ensure correct packaging and installation within the overall product/vehicle
  • architecture:
  • space allocation, collision-free design, mounting concepts
  • consideration of thermal, mechanical, and environmental constraints
  • Define and implement design rules and modelling standards to ensure consistency
  • and quality.
  • Support integration of electrical and electronic components (e.g., HW, harness,
  • connectors) into the mechanical environment.
  • Perform:
  • clash/clearance analyses
  • tolerance analyses (dimension chains, variability)
  • Enable manufacturability:
  • support design for manufacturing (DFM), assembly (DFA), and serviceability
  • Maintain data quality in PLM/PDM systems (structure, versioning, release).
  • Support change management (ECR/ECO) by updating models and ensuring
  • consistency across assemblies.
  • Collaborate closely with:

HW design, harness design, system engineering, and manufacturing

  • Provide 3D data and documentation for:
  • simulation, validation, and supplier interfaces


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Expert-level proficiency in CATIA (or comparable CAD tools), including:
  • 3D modeling (parts, assemblies)
  • surface and solid design o kinematics and installation studies
  • Strong understanding of:
  • mechanical design principles (materials, tolerances, fastening methods)
  • packaging and integration in complex systems (e.g., vehicle environment)
  • interpret system and architectural requirements and translate them into 3D designs
  • perform and evaluate clash, clearance, and tolerance analyses
  • manufacturing processes (injection molding, machining, sheet metal, etc.) o integration of electrical/electronic components (ECUs, connectors, harness routing)
  • data management in PLM/PDM systems
  • applying CAD standards, naming conventions, and release processes
  • Analytical and structured problem-solving skills, especially for integration conflicts

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Organizar, acompanhar e reportar o desempenho operacional diário de uma equipe de 6 SDRs, cuidando do dia a dia do time (resolvendo bloqueios, dando coaching e apoio) para que a equipe cumpra suas metas de atividade e geração de pipeline. Deve acompanhar os SDRs nos alinhamentos com os comerciais.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência: 2 a 3 anos de experiência como SDR/BDR com resultados comprováveis; desejável ao menos 1 ano liderando ou coordenando uma equipe pequena de prospecção

  • Relatórios e análise: Excel (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas); desejável experiência com Power BI, Looker ou dashboards nativos do CRM
  • Conhecimento comercial: Gestão de KPIs de SDR (taxa de conexão, conversão em oportunidade, atividade diária, SQLs gerados, cumprimento de cota) e de metodologias de outbound / inbound (cadências de e-mail, cold calling, sequências)
  • Gestão de pessoas: Capacidade de dar feedback e coaching adaptado a diferentes níveis de senioridade dentro da mesma equipe (desde SDRs em formação até SDRs sêniores)
  • Idiomas: Português (Brasil) — preferencial; Espanhol — desejável
  • Organização e planejamento: Distribuir leads/contas entre os 6 integrantes da equipe, montar e ajustar a agenda diária/semanal, e garantir que as cadências e sequências estejam funcionando corretamente nas ferramentas
  • Acompanhamento da equipe: Monitorar a atividade diária (ligações, e-mails, reuniões agendadas) de cada SDR em relação à sua meta individual —ajustada ao seu nível de experiência—, manter 1:1 periódicos e identificar a tempo quando alguém está ficando atrás
  • Comunicação com sua liderança: Manter uma comunicação direta, frequente e transparente com sua liderança, informando avanços, riscos e necessidades da equipe, e validando prioridades e decisões operacionais do dia a dia

  • Cuidado com a equipe / suporte diário: Resolver bloqueios operacionais do dia a dia (problemas com ferramentas, dúvidas de processo, falta de leads), dar coaching e feedback constante de acordo com o nível de cada pessoa, e motivar a equipe (gamificação, reconhecimentos)

title: Senior Market Research Analyst
description:
About us:

At Toluna, we keep the world’s biggest brands one step ahead of their markets, their competitors, and their customers. For 25+ years we’ve been a leader in consumer insights, and today we’re at the center of our industry’s biggest shift: the move to AI-powered research grounded in real human truth.


Brands come to us because we’ve solved a problem most of our industry is still wrestling with: how to move fast without losing trust in the answer. Speed comes from AI we’ve been developing in-house since 2019, always-on platforms, and a 79M+ validated consumer community across 100+ countries.


Introduction:

We are looking for a senior market research analyst to join our amazing team in Brazil! You are the ideal candidate for this role if you have at least 4 years of market research experience, ideally on the supplier side. In this position, you will be responsible for leading the full project life cycle, from set-up through client presentations.


You’ll work across multiple research methodologies within Product & Innovation (idea and concept testing, market exploration, and packaging testing) and Brand & Communication (advertising testing, media and campaign effectiveness, brand assessment) in a dynamic environment, where AI-powered solutions are already a reality.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and execution of research projects to meet complex needs with minimal support.
  • Independently manage medium-to-highly complex quantitative & qualitative studies across a variety of methodologies from survey design through final delivery to clients.
  • Develop compelling, story-led analyses and final reports with strategic, clear, and engaging client presentations.
  • Responsible for leading final client presentations, providing consistent, clear, and actionable recommendations.
  • Manage all client communications, providing clear and proactive communication regarding project progress.
  • Manage multiple projects at once in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work together with project managers and operations for deployment and execution while maintaining overall management of timelines.
  • Share your expertise with junior and mid-level research analysts, acting as a knowledge multiplier and recognized as a strong technical contributor within the team.


Your profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree and at least 4 years of market research experience.
  • Experience in various research methodologies such as ad-hoc, ad concept testing, ad pre-testing, campaign evaluation, pack testing, brand tracking, shopper research, segmentation, U&A, iHUTs, etc.
  • Demonstrated success in questionnaire design, analysis, client presentation, and project management.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop effective working relationships with both internal partners and external clients.
  • Languages: English proficiency is mandatory; additional language skills are a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills with an ability to multitask and effectively prioritize own workload.


**Please submit your CV in English


Our Values:

A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability

B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial

C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness

D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly

E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, meal voucher, transportation voucher, TotalPass and language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: Analista de Risco Sênior
description:
Segmento: Instituição Financeira


Principais Responsabilidades:

title: Field Application Engineer
description:
Our client is a fast-growing pioneer in the agricultural robotics space, revolutionizing the farming industry by designing and building advanced, autonomous farm machines. By utilizing cutting-edge computer vision and machine learning, their technology enables farmers to understand and manage fields at a plant-by-plant level.

Backed as an independent subsidiary of one of the world's most respected global agricultural machinery giants, they combine the agile, fast-paced environment of a high-tech startup with the massive scaling power of an industry leader. Their mission is to improve global food production, increase farming profitability, and protect the environment by dramatically reducing pesticide use.


THE ROLE: FIELD APPLICATION ENGINEER (BRAZIL)

We are seeking a hands-on Field Application Engineer based in Brazil to help develop, support, and maintain next-generation "smart" farm machines. In this role, you will be the bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will carry out in-field product testing, troubleshoot complex electro-mechanical systems, and provide the crucial feedback needed to drive continuous product development.

This is an immediate-start opportunity with exciting potential to travel to the United States during the Brazilian off-season.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Field Application Engineer, your primary focus will be supporting smart machinery performance directly in the field:

  • In-Field Testing: Carry out hardware, software, and machine vision field tests on mechatronic agricultural machinery, providing detailed execution reports and documentation.
  • Technical Support: Collect field data, troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical issues on-site.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the vital link between customers, product management, agronomy, and engineering to communicate real-world user needs.
  • Documentation: Assist engineering teams in creating comprehensive product documentation, user guides, and instructional materials.
  • Systems Management: Track and manage recurring technical issues from initial identification to final resolution.
  • Logistics & Setup: Perform hands-on setup, maintenance, calibration, and transport of field-testing equipment as required.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Minimum Requirements:

  • Language Skills: Full professional fluency in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal).
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Engineering, Computer Science, Agriculture, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience: Experience supporting, troubleshooting, or maintaining complex agricultural electro-mechanical systems (large machinery).
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Strong ability to diagnose complex systems spanning hardware, software, and mechanical components.
  • Communication & Mindset: Excellent customer-facing skills with a collaborative, team-oriented attitude.
  • Mobility: Valid driver's license with a safe driving record, and a strong willingness to travel frequently to agricultural fields.


Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred but not required):

  • Familiarity with Linux environments and basic script programming.
  • Experience in designing and executing Design Verification Testing (DVT).
  • Basic programming/scripting skills in Python.
  • Familiarity with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks).


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS

  • This is an active, hands-on role in an outdoor environment. You should be comfortable standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and climbing in various weather conditions (hot and cold).
  • Ability to frequently lift/move items up to 25 pounds (and occasionally up to 50 pounds).
  • Strong visual acuity (including color vision and depth perception) to work with advanced camera and machine vision systems.


WHAT'S ON OFFER

  • Competitive Compensation Package with a highly collaborative, supportive, and forward-thinking work culture.
  • Fully Equipped: All tools, specialized equipment, and work vehicles are provided by the employer.
  • Travel Covered: 100% reimbursement for all work-related travel expenses.
  • Global Exposure: Unique opportunities for international collaboration and travel to US headquarters.

Nossa equipe de Contencioso e Arbitragem representa clientes nacionais e estrangeiros em procedimentos judiciais em primeira e segunda instâncias, tanto na Justiça Estadual quanto Federal, e nos tribunais superiores, em procedimentos arbitrais ad hoc e sob as regras das principais instituições arbitrais brasileiras e internacionais.

Nossa prática tem experiência com disputas envolvendo direito do consumidor, antitruste, direito bancário e financeiro, mercado de capitais, direito societário, direito dos contratos, infraestrutura (construção, mineração, energia e óleo e gás), contratos administrativos, marítimo, tecnologia da informação, seguros, ONGs, previdenciário, direito da sucessão, financiamento de projetos, imobiliário, telecomunicações, transações societárias (M&A), matéria ambiental, e disputas envolvendo companhias públicas e seus acionistas.

Esta posição é para uma equipe de contencioso de direito digital. A equipe atua em casos sensíveis e sofisticados envolvendo as principais empresas do setor de tecnologia, que oferecem serviços de redes sociais, mensageria privada, hospedagem de conteúdo, jogos eletrônicos, streaming de vídeo e música, marketplaces , nuvem, entre outros negócios digitais e inovadores. A carteira da equipe abrange casos judiciais e administrativos sobre temas atuais e importantes para essa indústria.

Conheça mais sobre o contencioso de tecnologia do Mattos Filho:


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar em contencioso e pré-contencioso cível focado em tecnologia;
  • Acompanhar processos judiciais e administrativos estratégicos para os clientes;
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes e reportar evolução dos casos;
  • Participar da definição de estratégia junto da equipe e de clientes;
  • Redigir petições, elaborar memorandos e apresentações;
  • Revisar petições elaboradas por advogados juniores;
  • Participar de audiências judiciais.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Direito com OAB ativa;
  • Pós-graduação em Direito Digital será um diferencial;
  • Experiência em contencioso cível estratégico. Atuação prévia com temas relacionados ao Marco Civil da Internet e Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados não é obrigatória, mas será um diferencial;
  • Atuação prévia em escritórios full service ou em escritórios especializados em resolução de disputas ou com foco em direito digital será um diferencial;
  • Experiência com casos e clientes estrangeiros;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente é mandatório.

Sobre nós

O Mattos Filho é um escritório de alta performance, líder nas suas áreas de atuação, oferecendo trabalho de excelência e inovador para seus clientes em mais de 40 áreas do Direito. Com estrutura full-service, estamos presentes em locais estratégicos e temos grupos de trabalho regionais, que garantem a proximidade com clientes e parceiros no Brasil e em diversos países, impulsionando a geração de negócios e a tomada de decisões importantes.

Somos reconhecidos no mercado pela excelência e eficiência do nosso atendimento. No Chambers Brazil Awards, somos recordistas na categoria Brazil Law Firm of the Year , tendo sido eleitos por sete vezes como o escritório do ano no país. Resultados como esse são possíveis pois valorizamos e impulsionamos talentos, desenvolvendo competências e criando oportunidades que impactem positivamente a carreira de nossos profissionais.

Nosso pioneirismo também se reflete em ações que evidenciam o papel social da advocacia, como a nossa atuação pro bono e as iniciativas voltadas à promoção da diversidade, equidade e inclusão, que buscam contribuir para a promoção do Direito e a construção de uma sociedade mais justa e igualitária.

title: Integration Architect
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning


At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.


This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.


Integration Architect


At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.


What you’ll do for us

  • Design, build and deploy effective SSIS packages to validate, synthesize, transform customer data for integrated business planning and analytics.
  • Understand o9 platform’s data model (table structures, linkages, optimal designs) for designing various planning use cases.
  • Review and analyze the data provided by customers along with its technical/functional intent and interdependencies.
  • Lead customer sessions in the technical design, data requirements gathering and making recommendations on best practices, in case of inaccurate or missing data.
  • Design and automate the data loading and insights generation process with intelligent checks and balances for sustained value delivery.
  • Design and support execution of test plans, document issues and track progress at resolving issues.


What you’ll have


Experience:

  • 8+ Years. Experience with planning applications.
  • Experience in building scalable ML frameworks by identifying and collecting relevant input data, feature engineering, tuning, and testing.
  • ETL development with at least 1 year in designing ETL solutions for clients is a MUST.
  • (SSIS is preferred)
  • Experience in Creating/Testing Web API via Postman /C#/ JavaScript.
  • Good to have experience working with Hive/Hadoop/Python.
  • Knowledge and experience in Apache NiFi / Apache Airflow.
  • Prior work experience on Supply chain.
  • Strong experience in Cloud Data Quality, Source Systems Analysis, Business Rules Validation, Source Target Mapping Design, Performance Tuning and High-Volume Data Loads.
  • Education: BE/Btech/Mtech/MCA.


Skills:

  • Languages: SQL , MDX, T-SQL with knowledge of DDL, DML, stored procedures, triggers and performance tuning is a must. Leveraging ETL tools like SSIS for data transformations. Python, Bash, and/or Powershell Scripting; Amazon Web Services (AWS), AZURE, Google Cloud Infrastructures preferred.
  • Some Knowledge of C# /JavaScript / VB.NET or analytical packages like R is desirable.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel/PowerPoint /Visio for analysis and presentation
  • Knowledge on handling JSON files, Serializing the data, Posting data to API is desirable.
  • Strong Technical and communications skills.


What We Offer


  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.


How the process works


  • Apply – Submit your application by clicking the Link below.
  • Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  • Online Assessment - (If Applicable)
  • Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  • Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  • Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  • HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.


More about us…


At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.


With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.


o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Gerente de Talent Augmentation (Alocações)
description:

Competências Técnicas:


  • Experiência em Talent Augmentation, staffing, outsourcing, alocação de profissionais ou serviços de consultoria, preferencialmente no mercado de tecnologia.
  • Forte capacidade de gestão de clientes e desenvolvimento de negócios, identificando oportunidades dentro de contas existentes e novos mercados.

  • Capacidade de atuação em ambientes internacionais e multiculturais, com inglês avançado para relacionamento com clientes, parceiros e equipes globais.


Competências Comportamentais:


  • Atua de forma colaborativa com clientes, parceiros e equipes internas e internacionais, conectando pessoas, competências e oportunidades em benefício dos resultados coletivos.
  • Constrói relações de confiança e longo prazo, compreendendo as necessidades de clientes, parceiros e profissionais e buscando soluções sustentáveis para todas as partes.
  • Atua de forma proativa e orientada a negócios, antecipando necessidades, identificando oportunidades e entregando soluções que gerem valor além do esperado


O que oferecemos:


Um ambiente de trabalho estimulante e dinâmico, com oportunidades de desenvolvimento em um contexto internacional.

Crescimento acelerado de carreira, com diversas possibilidades de desenvolvimento horizontal e vertical, incluindo mobilidade internacional, treinamentos e certificações.

Equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com cultura remote-first possibilitando atuação em trabalho remoto ou híbrido.

Investimento contínuo no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores, além de eventos periódicos com as equipes e encontros anuais.

Somos certificados pelo Happy at Work e seguimos ouvindo ativamente nossos colaboradores. Se você valoriza uma cultura que respeita a diversidade, incentiva a coragem, a integridade, a excelência e a colaboração entre as pessoas, a HR Path é o lugar para você.


Esperamos você em breve na HR Path!

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

O desafio

Você fará parte de um time responsável por transformar desafios relevantes de negócio em diagnósticos, estratégias, iniciativas priorizadas e planos concretos de implementação .

O programa contempla duas grandes frentes:

  • Transformação Comercial: diagnóstico da performance comercial, identificação de oportunidades ao longo do funil, análise de produtividade e eficiência, entendimento da jornada do cliente e construção de iniciativas para crescimento de receita.
  • Estratégia de Crescimento: construção de teses de crescimento, identificação de novas oportunidades de mercado e modelos de negócio, análise de concorrência e tendências, dimensionamento de oportunidades e construção de business cases.


O que você vai fazer

Dependendo da senioridade e da frente de atuação, você poderá:

  • Estruturar problemas complexos e transformar hipóteses em análises e recomendações;
  • Analisar dados comerciais, financeiros, de clientes e de mercado;
  • Diagnosticar funis, conversão, produtividade e performance comercial;
  • Realizar pesquisas, entrevistas e benchmarks com clientes, mercado e concorrentes;
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento, eficiência e novos negócios;
  • Conduzir análises de mercado, concorrência, portfólio e tendências;
  • Construir modelos financeiros, cenários e business cases;
  • Priorizar iniciativas considerando impacto, atratividade e esforço;
  • Construir roadmaps e planos de implementação;
  • Preparar apresentações e recomendações para discussões executivas;
  • Participar de workshops e interações com lideranças;
